text.+1 PM à chaque poussée: +1 MP each time it is pushed
text.1 PA à son CaC, début de tour: 1 AP in its melee, turn start
text.1 PM par tour à son personnage: 1 MP per turn from its character
text.100 % de résistance dans un élément au h: 100% resistance in a random element. Once summoned for 3 turns, on its turn it gives -200% resistance in that element to whatever touches it, for 3 turns: stick it to Gourlo. Keep the ones of your element.
text.100 % de résistances partout. Le Moon pe: 100% resistances everywhere. Moon loses his resistance in an element when that element's totem, summoned by Darkli Moon, is placed on his glyph.
text.16 PA au départ, +1 PA par tour pendant: 16 AP at start, +1 AP per turn for 5 turns: dispel him every turn, at 20 AP he casts Dazing Stone every turn. Hitting him with Neutral gives his allies a 3,000 shield.
text.20 PM : il court à ton contact et explos: 20 MP: it runs into your melee and explodes (damage in a random element), then dies. Hard to avoid.
text.3 Goules en jeu, ou l'éroder: 3 Ghouls in play, or erode her
text.3 vagues de monstres. Un monstre à 10 %: 3 waves of monsters. A monster at 10% HP enters Lotus: kill its double before its 4th turn.
text.400 % de résistances partout. Frappé Ter: 400% resistances everywhere. Hit Earth/Water, the Disciple places its glyphs at odd distance; Air/Fire: even. A Kimbo starting its turn on a glyph loses 400% resistances in that pair for 1 turn.
text.Abnégation : les alliés proches de lui s: Selflessness: allies near him are sacrificed for 2 turns, he takes their damage.
text.Applique de l'érosion autour de lui et r: Applies erosion around him and reduces healing received.
text.Applique un poison qui blesse selon les: Applies a poison that hurts based on MP used.
text.Après 5 attaques subies, chaque monstre: After taking 5 attacks, each monster triggers an effect based on the season. At end of turn, the Hunting Altar replays the monsters' spells and effects, weakened, on the nearest entity. Waves on turns 1, 6, 11…
text.Après Griffes enflammées, être poussé ou: Blazing Claws: after it, being pushed or taking pushback damage makes him skip his turn.
text.Attendre une Bombombre à Eau, la placer: Wait for a Water Cucumbomb, place it at the edge facing the islet and hit it in melee without killing it: the character is teleported onto the islet. If not in contact with Nagate on her turn, they're sent back.
text.Au CaC, il peut faire passer son tour. L: In melee, it can make you skip your turn. The character under Plot Twist takes the damage of allies within 6 range: move away from them.
text.Au début de son tour, elle attire de 2 c: At the start of its turn, it pulls those in line or diagonal with it by 2 cells: do not end your turn in its lines and diagonals.
text.Au début de son tour, il tue les monstre: At the start of its turn, it kills monsters at 10% HP or less (even far away) and gains MP and damage: bring them to 10% without finishing them. A summon can finish a monster safely.
text.Au début de son tour, il tue tout person: At the start of its turn, it kills any character at 10 range or more: stay within 9 range and keep MP, as Yortukloss pushes back and removes MP. Under Distanss, each hit it takes pushes the attacker back.
text.Au tour 7, même mort, il reprend tous se: On turn 7, even if dead, it regains all its HP, returns to its starting cell, dispels everything, kills summons and removes AP. Don't remove its AP or MP or push it (it buffs itself). Dodges weapons in melee.
text.Au-dessus de 50 % PV : Fraktale à plus d: Above 50% HP: with Fraktal over 4 cells from the Aurour, she advances and spells hurt; at 4 cells or less, she retreats and spells heal. Under 50% HP, it's reversed.
text.Au-dessus de 50 % PV, attire son attaqua: Above 50% HP, pulls its attacker 1 cell; below, gains critical damage per damage line taken.
text.Au-dessus de 50 % PV, chaque coup reçu s: Above 50% HP, each hit taken heals its allies around it; below, half the damage dealt is spread around it, allies included.
text.Au-dessus de 50 % PV, retire 2 PO à qui: Above 50% HP, removes 2 range from whoever hits it; below, gains MP and Dodge per hit taken. Lays poisons from range.
text.Aucun soin possible de tout le combat. S: No healing possible all fight. Under their state, hitting the Icy Brockhard in melee removes 100 MP from the team and the Pyrotechnic Brockhard steals HP.
text.Aucun sort de frappe : ses dégâts vienne: No damaging spell: her damage comes from the turn-start poison and the Fountains' glyphs (stay beyond 5 range). Removing AP or MP from her allies gives them AP or makes them pull.
text.Augmente de 10 % les dommages de ses all: Increases its allies' damage by 10% (20% for the Crocabulia). Dies on its own after 4 turns; killed earlier, it hits Earth and cuts your damage by 20% in an 8-cell circle: finish it from beyond 8 range.
text.Augmente les dégâts que tu subis et tape: Increases the damage you take and hits at range; removing its range limits its actions.
text.Avant chaque seuil de 20 % PV, se placer: Before each 20% HP threshold, get out of range of the weapon that appears and kill it before its turn (else resistances, MP, heals). In Fearless state, only the Fearless target hits her without turning Pacifist; no more swapping with her weapons.
text.Avec 30 PM, il atteint toute l'équipe et: With 30 MP, he reaches the whole team and hits in melee and in an area around him, removing Vitality.
text.Beaucoup de PV pour leur niveau, mais pe: Lots of HP for their level, but little damage.
text.Bloqué contre un mur, il ne peut plus re: Stuck against a wall, he can no longer back off or hit.
text.Bolesh perd des PV chaque tour et meurt: Bolesh loses HP every turn and dies on its own: killing it next to Sam Wyz makes Sam Wyz vulnerable for 2 turns; elsewhere, wait for the next summon (4 turns).
text.Boubou réduit fortement les dégâts qu'il: Cover-Up greatly reduces melee damage he takes for 2 turns: hit him from range.
text.Branche Paralysante : poison de 3 tours: Paralysing Branch: 3-turn poison that hurts per AP used, dispellable.
text.Brûlure si on déplace un monstre: Burn if you move a monster
text.Bulbronce : l'allié ciblé, frappé, renvo: Bulbramble: the targeted ally, when hit, reflects part of the damage onto the cells in contact.
text.CaC, croît à chaque coup reçu: melee, grows with each hit taken
text.CaC, début de tour sur glyphe: melee, turn start on a glyph
text.CaC, en ligne si vulnérable: melee, in a line when vulnerable
text.CaC, le tour après être frappé: melee, the turn after being hit
text.Cauchemar si aucun ennemi en vue: Cauchemar if no enemy in sight
text.Ces effets durent tant que Poison Incura: These effects last while Incurable Poison is active (2 turns): wait it out if you can't kill it in one turn. Kills summons in melee.
text.Change de saison (et de sorts) à 70 % et: Changes season (and spells) at 70% and 30% HP, then cannot be hit until its turn. At the start of its turn, pushes the closest one in line 20 cells: don't line up. Stronger every turn.
text.Chaque Nimpatience réduit ses dégâts sub: Each Stubbygerness level reduces his damage taken. Letting him hit a character stops it rising. At Stubbygerness 3, he teleports the 4 nearest enemies into his melee.
text.Chaque Tanuki est invulnérable sur un gé: Each Tanuki is invulnerable on a geoglyph: hitting it at range pulls it 2 cells, in melee pushes it 2. Keep the monsters apart.
text.Chaque Tynril met une faiblesse énorme d: Each Tynril gives the nearest character a huge weakness in its element: keep it away from key characters or push it back. Each turn, it swaps places with another Tynril.
text.Chaque coup au CaC retire 1 PM à la cibl: Each melee hit removes 1 MP from the target for the fight (5 per turn). Monsters boost every 2 turns: +50% damage on turn 2.
text.Chaque coup d'un monstre baisse la résis: Each monster hit lowers its target's resistance and its own in its element: stay at range. The Loutbear's sharing protects targeted monsters.
text.Chaque coup reçu réduit la relance de Fr: Each hit taken cuts the cooldown of Cardinal Strike, which hits the 4 nearest characters.
text.Chaque début de tour, elle fait exploser: At each turn start, she blows up Shells in line or diagonal with her; a Shell within 3 cells of another also explodes, not counting toward invulnerability. Stay 4 cells from Shells, keep them away from monsters.
text.Chaque déplacement (poussée, attirance,: Every displacement (push, pull, teleport, swap) removes Power: don't move your allies, stand in a corner.
text.Chaque ligne d'attaque renforce ses rési: Each attack line strengthens his resistances (Sprat): dispel him first. Healing a target under White Plague dispels it.
text.Chaque ligne de dégâts d'un monstre sur: Each damage line from a monster on a character gives it Stubbygerness (+20% final damage, new spells): keep monsters at range; MP reduction helps.
text.Chaque ligne de dégâts lui donne 30 % de: Each damage line gives it 30% resistance in that element (2 turns); each debuff spell removes 30% in all elements. When it dies, it fully heals every monster.
text.Chaque ligne de dégâts sur un Pichon lui: Each damage line on a Snapper removes 1% of his resistance and is reflected onto him; his death wins the fight. Scrub is cast at 3+ range with line of sight: lock him or hide. 0 pushback resistance.
text.Chaque monstre devient invisible à son 1: Each monster turns invisible on its 1st turn and summons its Malterego (other spells, less HP). Killed before its 1st turn, it summons none; once its Malterego dies, it is visible again and weakened.
text.Chaque monstre qui meurt donne des résis: Each dying monster gives resistances to the other monsters.
text.Chaque monstre tué laisse un glyphe sur: Each monster killed leaves a glyph on its cell and revives next turn, skips that turn and keeps -1 MP: eroding it brings it back with low HP.
text.Chaque mort de monstre affaiblit l'équip: Each monster death weakens the team. Hit the Orfan from range, the Kannihilator in melee (he reflects ranged spells).
text.Chaque perso mort le booste en PM et en: Each dead character buffs its MP and Power for the whole fight: keep everyone alive.
text.Chaque personnage dans sa ligne de vue l: Each character in his line of sight gives him range, damage and HP (3 times max). Each Lantern effect removes 2 of these boosts.
text.Chaque poussée lui donne 1 PM pour le co: Each push gives it 1 MP for the rest of the fight, each hit taken strengthens Necessary Roughness (melee, area). Don't push it, kill it with few hits and stay out of its melee range.
text.Chaque sort augmente ses dommages de pou: Each spell raises his pushback damage. Don't stay near an obstacle or diagonal to him.
text.Chaque sort de monstre pose une rune sou: Each monster spell leaves a rune under its target: don't end your turn on it, it hurts characters and heals monsters. Erosion limits these heals.
text.Chaque tentative de retrait PM soigne le: Each attempt to remove MP heals the monsters for 15% of their HP; each attempt to remove AP gives him 1 MP for the fight.
text.Chaque tour, chaque personnage reçoit un: Each turn, each character gets a Rage element: a spell of that element, even on an empty cell, adds 1 (special validation: hit her); otherwise 500 damage. At 6, vulnerable and much stronger: not before the monsters die.
text.Chaque tour, un perso Empathique prend 5: Each turn, an Empathic character takes 50% of the damage dealt to Poison Amy. Don't remove her AP or MP (shield). A dead character becomes a Dark Treeckler that fights against you.
text.Chaque Éclat tué augmente ses dommages :: Each Chip killed raises her damage: kill 3 once the monsters are dead. She summons one every 2 turns, which makes her invulnerable again: once at III, killing it is enough to make her vulnerable.
text.Chaque élément tapé réduit de 50 % ses d: Each element he's hit with cuts his damage taken in that element by 50% for 1 turn. With all 4 element states, he loses this reduction but his spells hit harder.
text.Chocolathée si on tape l'Éclat: Chocolathiest if you hit the Chip
text.Chocomatose : +300 puissance et +3 PA pe: Chocomatose: +300 Power and +3 AP for 2 turns, monsters included. While a player has it, monsters (except him) can teleport into melee with an enemy.
text.Cinq vagues : finir vite chaque vague po: Five waves: finish each wave fast to avoid stacking them. Watch the monster in Moggymorphosis.
text.Collée au Sphincter Cell avec un personn: Next to Sphincter Cell with a character adjacent to it, on its turn it gives them -200% resistance in its element for 2 turns (red Fire, yellow Air, green Earth, blue Water). With no character adjacent, nothing.
text.Comme tous les monstres, invoque une Coq: Like all monsters, summons a Shell every 4 turns; on the Crocabulia, a Shell's bonus is doubled.
text.Commence avec un bouclier de la moitié d: Starts with a shield worth half its HP; loses 50% resistances on turn 4.
text.Commencer son tour dans le glyphe d'une: Starting its turn in another Royal Jelly's glyph removes its resistances in that glyph's element.
text.Coup de Foudre met Foudroyé ; en Bretteu: Love at First Sight inflicts Scorch; in Bretteur Céleste (turns 3, 7, 11…) it casts it again to kill a Scorch target in melee. Keep Scorch targets away on those turns, it can teleport to them.
text.Crachat Amer ne vise qu'une cible déjà t: Bitter Spit only targets someone already hit by Engulfment and Tongue Flicks. High Initiative.
text.Cri de Reconstitution soigne beaucoup el: Cry of Recovery heals her or an ally a lot (7-turn cooldown): damage her and isolate her.
text.Croûte retire PO, PA puis PM et fait pas: Crust removes range, AP then MP and skips the turn 3 turns later: dispel before. Each Water hit heals it, each Earth hit boosts its Power. It cannot be pushed or carried.
text.Cyclaustrophobe : toute entité de la zon: Cyclostrophobe: any entity in the area hit in melee returns to its turn-start cell and gains damage.
text.Dans l'état Lourd. Ses glyphes entourent: In the Heavy state. Its glyphs surround the team from the start of the fight, and it pushes or swaps places to send you into them.
text.Tous les monstres du donjon, Kwakwa comp: Every monster in the dungeon, Kwakwa included: each pushback damage taken removes 10% resistances from it and gives it 10 pushback damage for 3 turns (stackable, not dispellable).
text.Descend de sa monture 3 tours, puis reme: Dismounts for 3 turns, then gives Kissiphrot back to all. Bacteriological Bomb gives a monster a shield and a disease that explodes around it at turn end. Gravity stops him from swapping places.
text.Destinos (tours 1, 4, 7…) désenvoûte, tr: Destinos (turns 1, 4, 7…) dispels, turns into Tofu, removes 100 AP, poisons and pushes back around him: move away, effects are dispellable. Keep him at range. Also summons Thrown Tofus.
text.Devient le Scarafeuille de son élément d: Becomes the Scaraleaf of its resistance element, more dangerous.
text.Donne 2 PM à ses alliés pendant 4 tours: Gives its allies 2 MP for 4 turns (4 MP to the Crocabulia). Dies on its own after 4 turns; killed earlier, it hits Air and removes 4 MP in an 8-cell circle: finish it from beyond 8 range.
text.Donne un bouclier à ses alliés à chaque: Gives its allies a shield each turn (double for the Crocabulia). Dies on its own after 4 turns; killed earlier, it hits Water and raises your damage taken by 20% in an 8-cell circle: finish it from beyond 8 range.
text.Durakuir : chaque monstre gagne résistan: Tuffguy: each monster gains resistances and damage as it loses HP. Hit one monster at a time, no area spells, and keep the others away (MP removal). A monster's killer gains “Fren?”.
text.Dès le tour 2, partage les dommages entr: From turn 2, shares damage among all monsters (2 turns, 3-turn cooldown).
text.Dès le tour 3, Carapace d'Ailes 2 tours: From turn 3, Carapace of Wings for 2 turns: he stops playing, reflects damage and steals HP from everyone. He triggers all runes and summons Crobaks. His death removes his allies' 50% resistances.
text.Dès son 2e tour, chaque tentative de ret: From its 2nd turn, each attempt to reduce its AP gives it 4 AP, and its MP 3 MP, for the whole fight: do not reduce them.
text.Dès son 2e tour, le Tofukaz rend invisib: From its 2nd turn, the Tofukaz makes itself and nearby allies invisible. Back off to lure the fleeing Tofus. The very resistant Tofurby is hit with Water.
text.Dès son tour 3, il change un monstre res: From his turn 3, he turns a revived monster or a Zombie summon into a Sprout and loses his invulnerability. When he dies, he kills every character within 3 range of him and within 2 range of each Sprout.
text.Début de tour : échange de place avec un: Turn start: swaps places with a character in contact; Gravity or Rooted prevents it but deals big Fire damage. Vinriktus swaps the target with its nearest ally. Under Sit, limit his MP.
text.Délock : Naissances Voracle, Chasse Domp: Unlocks: Naissance (Voracle), Chasse (Killtamer), Repos (Touslecat) (5 hits, then the Altar copies the effect). Gains 1 permanent MP per monster in line with her. Dispel Brutank's sharing. Unerodable.
text.Désenvoûter le malus de résistance, surt: Dispel the resistance penalty, especially Earth or Air.
text.Dévoile les personnages invisibles à cha: Reveals invisible characters at the start of each of its turns: turning invisible is useless.
text.En Kewlitude (Koulosse tapé), il gagne 3: In Kewlitude (Koolich hit), it gains 3 AP, 3 MP, 100% final damage and heals itself. Not dangerous without this bonus.
text.En Matoumorphose, Vieillissement Prématu: In Moggymorphosis, Premature Ageing makes the target Pacifist for 1 turn.
text.En début de tour, vole les stats des mon: At turn start, steals stats from monsters in Collection state she can see; she loses them when they die. Carrions give her shield. Dakhma is removed by hitting the ally affected. Below 50% HP, finish her fast.
text.En fin de tour, gagne bouclier et tacle: At end of turn, gains shield and Lock per enemy within 4 range. A summon in his range can draw him for a turn or two.
text.En fin de tour, il échange de place avec: At the end of his turn, he swaps places with an enemy more than 4 range away. Under Haunted, use as few AP and MP as possible.
text.En mourant, lui et son Zoeuf échangent d: On death, he and his Bzzegg swap places with the nearest entity and hit it.
text.En sortant d'invisibilité (Surgissement): Coming out of invisibility (Pop-Up), those hit get Gravity and reflect half the damage they take around them for 2 turns.
text.Enlisement (tour 2 puis tous les 3 tours: Stymation (turn 2, then every 3 turns): 0 MP but +4 AP for everyone. Position yourself the turn before to benefit.
text.Esquive PA et PM, toute la carte: AP and MP Parry, whole map
text.Esquive tous les coups au CaC en reculan: Dodges every melee hit by stepping back one cell. Its spells reach 4 range at most: at 9 range or more, it cannot touch you.
text.Exi Guman, à sa mort, soigne tous ses al: Veg Hog, on death, heals all its allies to full and gives them Power. The Pumperwinkle appears next to a character and steals AP and characteristics within 2 range around it.
text.Explose après 4 tours s'il a une cible à: Explodes after 4 turns if a target is within 6 range: damage and dispel around it, death within 2 range. Also dies when Dremoan dies, killing every character within 2 range.
text.Exécution se lance à 2 PO sans ligne de: Execution is cast at 2 range without line of sight: push it far from a Cocoon and remove its MP.
text.Faire exploser la Poupée Affamée en la n: Make the Famished Doll explode by feeding it summons or giving it AP. Never end your turn in melee with a Lethal Doll.
text.Finir ses tours sur les glyphes blancs d: End your turns on white glyphs from turn 2. Pushing a character into him makes him vulnerable. Killing the other monsters before turn 3 gives one more turn before Pacifist.
text.Fonso Cacnoob finit à son CaC: Klaus Kombatnoob ends in its melee
text.Frapper Bonraphin à distance et Brâkloti: Hitting Bontangel at range and Brakimp in melee raises Bontarian Wrath and Brakmarian Wrath; at 10 each, state X: vulnerable 2 turns, big shield and big damage. Bontangel killed: vulnerable at range; Brakimp killed: in melee.
text.Frapper un monstre tue tes personnages d: Hitting a monster kills your characters in its lines and diagonals. Under Delayed Massacre, end your turn more than 6 cells from any monster. Stay above 50% HP: in line, it kills anyone below.
When hit, the Ectobomb explodes within 4 cells.
text.Frisette : chacun gagne 20 % de dégâts p: Frizzies: everyone gains 20% damage per enemy in line with them and loses 20% per ally in line: don't stay in line with an ally.
text.Gagne 1 000 Vitalité et 2 PM pour chaque: Gains 1,000 Vitality and 2 MP for each character or summon killed.
text.Gagne 1 PM par coup reçu. Mawatougeri fa: Gains 1 MP per hit taken. Meowashigeri makes you lose HP per MP used.
text.Gagne 1 PM à chaque fin de tour. Laisser: Gains 1 MP at the end of each turn. Letting a summon get killed in melee starts its 3-turn cooldown.
text.Gagne de la Puissance à chaque coup reçu: Gains Power with each hit taken during Targeted Power.
Gains Power with each hit taken.
text.Gagne de la Puissance à chaque fois qu'u: Gains Power each time a character takes damage. Can't be pushed or pulled.
text.Gagne de la Puissance à chaque tour par: Gains Power each turn for every character more than 3 range from him. Telepunch (2 to 5 range) makes him Invulnerable; one melee hit removes it. Beyond 12 range, he reaches no one.
text.Gagne des PM chaque tour. La Pesanteur l: Gains MP each turn. Gravity stops him from swapping places.
text.Gagne des dommages à chaque coup reçu et: Gains damage on every hit taken and steals lots of HP in melee.
text.Garder le Bwork à distance : il n'est da: Keep the Bwork at range: he is only dangerous in melee.
text.Garder les Kabushido à distance : au CaC: Keep the Kabushido at range: in melee, their hits grow with their missing HP.
text.Garder les monstres à distance. Déplacer: Keep monsters at a distance. Moving a monster gives Burn: the Skoul then sends it back to its starting cell and raises its damage taken.
text.Garder un perso à 5 PO ou moins au début: Keep a character within 5 range at the start of his turn, otherwise he becomes Invulnerable. He gains 1 MP per turn (10 max): the less he moves, the harder he hits, up to 10 range without line of sight.
text.Garder à distance les Cochons de Farle :: Keep Farle's Pigs at range: 3 turns after arriving, they explode in melee.
text.Gelé au début : sous 50 % PV il passe en: Frozen at first: below 50% HP he enters Thawing and changes spells (big Fire hit, Power boost for all).
text.Gelé, il donne 2 PM à tous ses alliés, S: Frozen, he gives 2 MP to all his allies, Itzting included, every 3 turns. Below 50% HP (Thawing), he hits at 11 range without line of sight.
text.Gelée blanche donne Instant au Zombi : l: Hoarfrost gives the Zombie Instant: killing it in melee with Grohlum makes him vulnerable until the killer's next turn.
text.Gloursbi-boulga : chaque coup reçu lui d: Bearbaroness: each hit taken gives it pushback damage. Dispel it or don't hit it.
text.Glusure : poison qui tape pour chaque PM: Glustick: poison that hits for each MP used during the turn.
text.Glyphe bleu : finir son tour dedans fait: Blue glyph: ending your turn in it skips your next turn. Monsters caught in its brown glyph when it is placed hurt Carter when hit. Killing the Mushroom gives Power around it.
text.Gonflage : poison qui tape selon les PM: Swelling: poison that hits per MP used. Avoid ending within 5 range of it.
text.Griffure Ondulante laisse des dégâts Ter: Undulating Scratch leaves endless Earth damage: a heal removes it.
text.Hanque : gagne des PV à chaque coup reçu: Hanke: gains HP on every hit taken for 4 turns.
text.Hitomi réduit ses dégâts subis et en ren: Hitomi reduces the damage he takes and reflects part of it. After Nozomi, the Lantern on him and his target removes the state; the two swap places when either is hit.
text.Il annule et renvoie les dégâts tant que: He cancels and reflects damage until his allies have hit him 3 times: put the Chak Rat in contact with him before his turn. Keep at least one monster alive until then.
text.Il bondit jusqu'à 12 PO au contact d'un: He leaps up to 12 range next to a character: Gravity prevents it.
text.Il change ce qu'il tue en Mulou. Tous le: He turns what he kills into Boowolves. Every 3 turns, he kills his Boowolves to heal; without Boowolves, he loses resistances: kill them every turn. Cornered by 2 summons, he eats them and stays stuck: replace them.
text.Il perd ses 100 % de résistances dans l': He loses his 100% resistances in the element of each Royal Blop killed: Pippin Earth, Indigo Water, Morello Cherry Fire, Coco Air.
text.Il pose sa Bave puis échange de place po: Places its Slobber then swaps places to put an enemy on it: move before its turn. Recast every 3 turns, not on turn 1. A Rooted or Gravity character can't be swapped.
text.Il se soigne entièrement à chaque tour :: Fully heals every turn: erode him or kill him in one turn. Made Unhealable, he removes the state and gains 1,000 Power for the whole fight.
text.Il se téléporte sur ses alliés : rester: It teleports onto its allies: stay away from all enemies. Kill it in one turn, or hit in melee then back off. Eating a summon gives it shield and MP for 4 turns (dispellable). MP removal keeps it at range.
text.Il tape en croix autour de lui au début: It hits in a cross around itself at the start of its turn, allies included: put it in contact with the White Rat.
text.Il tape jusqu'à 6 PO : rester hors de sa: He hits up to 6 range: stay out of reach. His summoned Blop lays a white glyph that removes 2 MP and kills a character ending their turn in it.
text.Il vole 3 PA à chaque perso ou invocatio: It steals 3 AP from each character or summon within 3 range at the start of its turn. At 16 AP it loses its invulnerability for 2 turns; at 20 AP it heals fully: only 2 neighbours, then move away.
text.Indéplaçable. L'Enfer des Zombies : ress: Unmovable. Zombie Hell: revives a dead dungeon monster each turn.
text.Inoffensif à distance : jouer à distance: Harmless at range: play at range or lock him. Meteor applies Meteoroid; on a Tyrannised target (Grozilla), it removes 50% of current HP. His rush on a Tyrannised target cancels his next turn.
Harmless at range: play at range or lock him. Tyrannisation applies Tyrannised; on a Meteoroid target (Grasmera), it removes 50% of current HP. His pull on a Meteoroid target cancels his next turn.
text.Inoffensif à distance. Coraillement Magi: Harmless at range. Masterly Coralaction: +12 AP but 0 MP for 4 turns (5-turn cooldown). Lots of HP, low resistances.
text.Instabilité Chaotique : chaque ligne de: Chaotic Instability: each damage line removes 5% resistance from the monster in the element hit and grants it elsewhere. Don't stay in a Demonic Arm's glyph on its turn.
text.Intacleur, frappe si on entre: Unable to Lock, hits on entry
text.Intérêts : lui et celui qui le tape gagn: Interest: he and whoever hits him gain Power with each hit. Under 50% HP, gains shield per damage line taken: hit him with big hits, dispel his shields.
text.Invocations à placer hors de sa vue et d: Place summons out of his sight and spread out. Invulnerable Minikron: if he kills it in melee, the team loses 2 AP and 20% res. Don't let it end on his black glyph (-MP, Erosion). Locking him blocks Shovellista.
text.Invoque Dagobert, qui vole des PA, de no: Summons Dagobert, who steals AP, again every 4 turns.
text.Invoque deux Dragoeufs au tour 1, puis u: Summons two Dreggons on turn 1, then one every 2 turns, and strongly boosts an ally.
text.Invoque un monstre du donjon tous les 6: Summons a dungeon monster every 6 turns.
text.Invoquer crée un Feu des âmes perdues ;: Summoning creates a Flames of Lost Souls; hitting it makes Gein visible and vulnerable for that turn if he is within 2 range. Then he teleports opposite the next player (or back to where his turn began).
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé A: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Air: do it last. Place it in front of the Kralove and have it kill a summon hidden from the Kralove's sight, 2 turns in a row, to make him vulnerable.
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé E: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Water. Block it with the other two on a protected summon: all three must hit it the same turn without killing it. +2 MP when the Kralove is vulnerable.
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé F: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Fire. Block it with the other two on a protected summon: all three must hit it the same turn without killing it. +2 MP when the Kralove is vulnerable.
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé T: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Earth. Block it with the other two on a protected summon: all three must hit it the same turn without killing it. +2 MP when the Kralove is vulnerable.
text.Invulnérable 1 tour en montant sur sa mo: Invulnerable for 1 turn when mounting, then finish her before she plays again. Dakhma is removed by hitting the ally affected. Trapped with summons in contact, she kills them into Carrions that block her.
text.Invulnérable 2 tours sur 3 (tours 2, 5,: Invulnerable 2 turns out of 3 (turns 2, 5, 8…): a character with Grill who starts their turn within 2 range of him makes him vulnerable. Don't reduce his range: +1 MP per removal.
text.Invulnérable au CaC au-dessus de 50 % PV: Invulnerable in melee above 50% HP, at range below.
Invulnerable in melee above 50% HP, at range below. Reduces its target's damage on Olgoths.
text.Invulnérable sauf le tour après avoir fi: Invulnerable except for the turn after he ends his turn in his blue cross (Hypertension). Locked in a corner, he casts his glyphs on the summons. -2 AP and a poison per MP used for the whole fight.
text.Jouer en ligne ou en diagonale pour gére: Play in lines or diagonals to handle the confusion.
text.Jouer à distance et tuer chaque vague vi: Play at range and kill each wave fast to avoid being overwhelmed. The character targeted by Toe Busker must hit the Levitrof before its turn.
text.Jouer à distance. L'Ivremor tape à dista: Play at range. The Drunkyller hits from range and lays Fire glyphs; the Hazwonarm gains 1 MP per hit taken; the Snickerblade (5 MP) quickly reaches melee.
text.Jusqu'à 2 par tour. 75 % de résistances,: Up to 2 per turn. 75% resistances, except -75% in a random element. Keep it away from the Bherb: it would restore all his HP.
text.Kackitu (autour de lui, tous les 7 tours: KilleRat (around him, every 7 turns): the target dies if it takes Earth or Neutral damage that turn. A summon in melee with him draws it. Don't heal under Black Plague (life steal doesn't count). Hit with Fire or Air.
text.Kwayauté : chaque monstre tué (invocatio: Kwayalty: each monster killed (summons included) removes 40% resistance in its element from him and gives him 40 pushback damage. Pushes back 4 cells in a line up to 7 range: avoid his lines and walls.
text.L'Aloevée Rate soigne ses alliés et fuit: The Aloevie Rat heals its allies and flees.
text.L'Atomystique ressuscite le dernier mons: The Atomystique revives the last dead monster every 2 turns; the revived monster dies with it.
text.L'Olgoth est invulnérable au CaC au-dess: The Olgoth is invulnerable in melee above 50% HP and at range below. The Slashmaster teleports onto you; each hit it takes speeds up the Soul-Swallower's Cardinal Strike.
text.L'amener à 14 PA (chaque PA retiré lui e: Bring him to 14 AP (each AP removed gives him one) so he casts Hololol (2 turns): each hit in an element lowers his resistance in that element.
text.L'état Pesanteur l'empêche de se télépor: The Gravity state stops her from teleporting onto your characters.
text.L'Œuf de la Mort attire ceux en ligne av: The Egg of Death pulls those in line with it, then explodes on its 2nd turn and kills every character within 4 cells: do not stay in line with it or within 4 cells.
text.La Bombe Illicale explose à son tour sui: The Bomb Ilical explodes on its next turn or on its death; it moves 3 cells closer to whoever hits a monster. Remove its MP.
text.La Boubourse boost les monstres. À 1 PV,: The Pouch boosts monsters. At 1 HP, it joins your side for 2 turns, then returns on contact.
text.La Cocolune attire tout le monde de 10 c: The Cocolune pulls everyone 10 cells, then makes those in its sight Pacifist and buffs King Kongoku if he is in it. Gravity while it lives. Killing it is pointless: summoned again 1 turn later.
text.La Lanterne agit sur les monstres : elle: The Lantern affects monsters: it reveals and hurts the Kitsounebi, reveals the Kaonashi, removes the Madura's state and kills the Bakazako's copies in its glyph.
text.La Lanterne des Spiritueurs le rend vuln: The Slayspirit Lantern makes him vulnerable but pushes monsters out of its glyph; outside the glyph they turn invisible for 2 turns. Block him against an obstacle so he stays visible.
text.La Larve Saphir soigne beaucoup un allié: The Sapphire Larva heals an ally a lot each turn.
text.La Léolhyène tue au 2e coup de Mort Sûre: The Leopena kills with a 2nd Certain Death on the same target, 2 turns after the first.
text.La Motte ne frappe que si on la tape, et: The Clump only strikes when hit, and then hits the whole team. The Treecherous gains damage when hit in melee.
text.La Peluche wabbit soigne énormément ses: The Stuffed Wabbit heals its allies massively. At loot 5 or more, the Prez' summon a Prez' Plozion that kills within 2 cells.
text.La Pesanteur l'empêche d'échanger de pla: Gravity prevents him from swapping places (Ganache).
Gravity prevents it from swapping places.
text.La Pesanteur sur lui ou sur le Phossile: Gravity on him or the Drhossil prevents the place swap.
text.La garder à distance, équipe espacée (Mo: Keep her at range, team spread out (Crossed Word in a cross up to 9 range). Bwork Regeneration (6-turn cooldown): leave a low-HP monster for her to cast it on, then kill her within 6 turns. Vulnerable to MP reduction.
text.La garder à plus de 3 PO. Une Goule rede: Keep her beyond range 3. A Ghoul turns back to normal when damaged by an ally or by itself. Cooperation teleports her into melee with a Ghoul and pulls nearby allies in line.
text.La nourrir d'invocations (2 par tour au: Feed it summons (2 per turn at most) or give it AP: at 8 AP it explodes and hits the whole team with Fire.
text.La plupart des monstres tapent au CaC ou: Most monsters hit in melee or at short range: stay at range. The Kami only hits diagonally: stay in line with her.
text.La pousser contre un obstacle lui retire: Pushing her into an obstacle removes 1 MP for the fight without breaking her condition; at 0 MP she skips her turns. Keep the Bashillus away from her.
text.La taper quand des Trégénaires vivent le: Hitting her while Trentanias live makes them Devoted: they come and explode in an area in melee with a character. Hitting an Egg heals for half the damage dealt.
text.La taper quand peu de Bonbombes sont pos: Hit her when few Bonbombs are out. Impending Death ends if a blue Bonbomb heals the character or the Queen dies. On her death, the team takes more damage until the end of the fight. Immune to bombs.
text.La taper sans aucun allié en ligne ou en: Hit her with no ally in line or diagonal with her.
text.La taper une fois par tour l'empêche d'i: Hitting her once per turn stops her summoning an Ioppressed (2 max). Gravity, Rooted or Unmovable prevent being sent back at turn start.
text.La taper à distance. Sorts surtout en li: Hit her from range. Spells mostly in line: stand opposite and remove her MP.
text.La tuer dans le même tour global que Gro: Kill her in the same round as Grozilla. Apocalypse one-shots the whole team if Grozilla is more than range 2 from her at the start of turns 6, 11, 16… Meteor on a Tyrannised target removes half its current HP.
text.Le Black Wo Wabbit met Pesanteur et atti: The Black Wo Wabbit applies Gravity and pulls; the Tiwobot pushes a lot.
text.Le Chienchien retire tous les PM au CaC: The Bow Wow removes all MP in melee, then reflects half the damage taken onto its target.
text.Le Crâmbo frappe très fort jusqu'à 15 PO: The Crambo hits very hard up to range 15 on targets at 100% HP: stay out of his sight or hit yourselves lightly. The Nemroz's traps remove AP and range and boost enemy spells.
text.Le Gobus tue les personnages en ligne av: The Gobshell kills characters in line with it after its 2nd turn. A summon in line makes it explode. The Bomma's poison strikes when the target is healed.
text.Le Hamrack (2 PM, indéplaçable) doit exp: The Hamrack (2 MP, Unmovable) must explode in melee with him (vulnerable 5 turns): push Buck toward it and block him. Trying to remove his MP gives him 3 MP. The blast hurts nearby allies.
text.Le Mominotor tue toutes les invocations: The Mumminotor kills all summons on the map every 6 turns.
text.Le Pyrasite est le vrai danger : gros dé: The Pyrasite is the real danger: big damage and an MP and Power boost for all monsters. Stay at range, they all hit up close.
text.Le Scarafeuille Noir devient dangereux d: The Black Scaraleaf becomes dangerous from its 2nd turn. Stay at range: Immature Scaraleaves and Sparks arrive as reinforcements.
text.Le Sombléro booste ses alliés et tape à: The Brocktis boosts its allies and hits at range; the Nightfoul removes AP and quickly reaches melee.
text.Le Tofutoflamme rend ses alliés invisibl: The Blastofu makes its allies invisible.
text.Le finir en un tour avant sa reconstitut: Finish him in one turn before his regeneration (around 20% HP). In Parted state, killing his legs (Father Kwismas) wins the fight; Half Father Kwismas removes MP, turns you into a gift (-4 AP, Weakened) and pushes. MP reduction gives him range.
text.Le frapper au CaC repousse de 4 ceux en: Hitting him in melee pushes those in line within 4 range back 4: an obstacle behind kills. The first hit deals no damage. Under Bearbarf, failing to dodge away from a monster kills.
text.Le frapper le rend visible et remet sa P: Hitting it makes it visible and resets its Power to zero: look for it every turn.
text.Le frapper le rend visible jusqu'à son t: Hitting it makes it visible until its turn. Each character in its melee range at the start of its turn reduces its damage. The Gobliterating Mine carrier must end its turn more than 3 range from allies.
text.Le frapper sans utiliser de PM ; son poi: Hit him without using MP; his Toxmosis poison (2 turns) ends on his death. Kill him before turn 6: Volatile Poison sets a glyph that raises damage taken. Saving Venom: the target takes more and heals its attackers.
text.Le frapper soigne les personnages à 5 PO: Hitting it heals characters within 5 range of it (each one's first hit).
text.Le frapper une fois par tour l'empêche d: Hitting him once per turn stops his AP and MP removal next turn, but he gains 10 MP and hits hard in melee. His removals also target summons (3 per turn).
text.Le garder loin. Plus de 100 % de résista: Keep him away. Over 100% resistances. For 2 turns after his Stubbygerness 3, each push or pull removes 5% resistances (kept); push: +10%. A summon 2 cells away reduces his leap to 1 cell.
text.Le garder sur une case 6 dans un coin, l: Keep him on a 6 cell in a corner, far from the waves, removing his MP. His Dice and white glyphs (full heal if you end on one) appear on the number he ends on. Big Eyes (turns 3, 6, 9…): Dice 4 = MP, Dice 6 = Power.
text.Le garder à distance. Dès le tour 3 puis: Keep him at range. From turn 3, then every 4 turns, Carapace of Wings for 2 turns: he barely moves, reflects damage, steals life from all. Don't hit him then: dispel it. His Crobak dispels and returns if killed.
text.Le guide ne donne pas de stratégie pour: The guide gives no strategy for this low-level dungeon: no monster there is flagged as dangerous.
The revived monster dies with her.
text.Le même tour : taper à l'arme le Yomi al: Same turn: hit the Yomi in line with him with a weapon (Fulguration) and push or pull the Yokai on his diagonal (Blurring). With both states, he loses invulnerability for 4 turns.
text.Le perso en Fonso Cacnoob (3 à 6 PO, un: The character under Klaus Kombatnoob (3 to 6 range, a different one each turn) must end their turn in his melee: vulnerable until that character's next turn. On turn 5, he also kills your summons. He cannot be carried.
text.Le plus dangereux des monstres, surtout: The most dangerous monster, especially within 4 range.
text.Le plus dangereux des monstres. La Pesan: The most dangerous monster. Gravity stops him from swapping places.
text.Le plus dangereux des monstres. Rester l: The most dangerous monster. Stay far from him and don't summon near the monsters being hit.
text.Le poison de Petit poison se retire en é: Poisoned Art's poison is removed by being healed.
text.Le porter, l'attirer, le transposer ou l: Carrying, pulling, transposing him or having a summon push him avoids Erosion and poison.
text.Le pousser ou l'attirer annule Hogo et r: Pushing or pulling him cancels Hogo and removes his glyph. The Lantern kills his copies inside his glyph.
text.Le pousser ou lui retirer des PM lui don: Pushing it or removing its MP gives it a shield; traps and glyphs buff it.
text.Le pousser ou tenter de lui retirer PA o: Pushing it or trying to remove its AP or MP makes it invulnerable for 2 turns; carrying and throwing it does not. Any pushback damage kills the character who takes it.
text.Le pousser, l'attirer, le téléporter ou: Pushing, pulling, teleporting or swapping places with it ends your turn: do it last. Only leave its melee range if the escape is certain: a failure kills everyone in its melee range.
text.Le premier coup du tour donné en ligne l: The first in-line hit of the turn pulls it into contact: moving it through a purple glyph puts it in Infection for 3 turns. Put it back in a glyph at least every 2 turns.
text.Le premier personnage touché dans le tou: The first character hit in the turn gets the Copperbeard state: she swaps places with them and removes all their MP. Hitting her in melee removes the state; Gravity blocks the swap.
text.Le premier à le frapper prend Marque des: The first character to hit it gets Marque des Mangelors for 1 turn: Voldelor can swap places with them, then kill them. Keep them beyond 9 range, or have an ally carry them.
text.Le repousser loin puis placer une invoca: Push it far away, then put a summon next to it: it kills it and becomes vulnerable for 1 turn, but Rooted. In Gravity, it can no longer teleport onto you.
text.Le retrait PM ou PO sert peu : les sorts: MP or range removal is of little use: spells reach range 12 and beyond.
Get him out of his glyph to hit him.
text.Le taper Feu puis le pousser : il invoqu: Hit him with Fire, then push him: he summons a Nugget to kill within 1 turn (2 turns for the next ones). Repeat with Air, Water, Earth. Each Nugget killed removes 25% of his HP; the 4th kills him.
text.Le taper au CaC seulement aux tours 3, 6: Hit him in melee only on turns 3, 6, 9… On odd turns from turn 3, he applies Pacifist to characters far from him, at ever closer range. The swap's pink glyph removes Dodge and Lock.
text.Le taper depuis son contact blesse le pe: Hitting it from contact hurts the character under Ectoparasite. Déjection: poison that hurts based on AP used.
text.Le taper à 2 PO ou moins attire au CaC e: Hitting him from range 2 or less pulls you into melee and triggers Certain Death on each hit. Under Deafened, Certain Death applies Unhealable and Gravity. Gains Vitality and damage on each monster death.
text.Le tuer dans le même tour global que Gra: Kill him in the same round as Grasmera. Peas in a Pod (turn 5, then every 5 turns): if Grasmera is more than range 2 from him on his next turn, she can cast Apocalypse and one-shot the whole team.
text.Le tuer en premier (tour 1 ou 2). Le dés: Kill him first (turn 1 or 2). Dispel him when he boosts: Fungal Ove fully heals him if hit, or if he loses AP or MP (one of the three, shown in preview). Sirop Spore: poison per AP used.
text.Les 2 Chafer Draugr sont la vraie menace: The 2 Draugur Chafers are the real threat: stay at range, remove their range, use little MP under Hel.
text.Les 8 Mouchâmes partagent leurs dégâts :: The 8 Replicaphids share their damage: hit them with area spells. Above 50% HP, each hit taken gives them Power; below 50%, Herd kills the target 3 turns later.
text.Les Bouftous des cavernes ne sont danger: Cave Gobballs are only dangerous when boosted by Kewlitude, when the Koolich is hit.
text.Les Branches gênent beaucoup : la Soigna: The Branches are a big nuisance: the Healing Branch heals hard, the Summoning Branch summons dungeon monsters.
text.Les Branches restent invulnérables tant: Branches stay invulnerable while the Soft Oak lives. Under the Healing Branch's effect, each move heals the nearest monster: move in one go.
text.Les Palmifleurs retirent 100 % de résist: Palmflowers remove 100% resistances: dispel the target.
text.Les Pichons sont invulnérables : les tap: Snappers are invulnerable: hit them with area and multi-line spells, each damage line counts against the Sponge Mob. Leave the Brown Snapper's red glyph before turn end.
text.Les Pépites croquantes résistent à dista: Crunchy Nuggets resist at range: hit them in melee.
text.Les bombes explosent au bout de 4 tours: The bombs explode after 4 turns or when killed, harder and wider over time (up to 3 range). If it swaps places with a bomb, the bomb explodes on its next turn. Avoid its diagonals.
text.Les dégâts au CaC sur lui sont presque a: Melee damage against it is almost cancelled. Your characters have -2 MP for the whole fight and lose 50% resistances each time they swap places or are teleported.
text.Les dégâts d'arme la rendent invulnérabl: Weapon damage makes her invulnerable: hit her with spells. Don't group the team in her areas (Power removal, erosion).
text.Les monstres invoqués sont invulnérables: Summoned monsters are invulnerable, die on their own in 4 turns and are more dangerous at low HP: survive by slowing them (MP removal, pushes). Healing Dark Bolt targets (Mantaze) removes Driver.
text.Les monstres ne jouent qu'à partir du to: Monsters only act from turn 3, unless hit. Hitting or killing a monster also alerts monsters within 3 range of it.
text.Les monstres posent en fin de tour un gl: At turn end, monsters lay a black glyph that inflicts Crackrockification. Hitting the affected ally in melee or with pushback removes it and strips Rocky Layer from nearby monsters.
text.Les monstres se renforcent au tour 1 et: Monsters get stronger on turn 1 and turn 4 (Intrepid state): end the fight fast.
text.Les monstres sont inoffensifs à distance: Monsters are harmless at range but hit very hard in melee: keep them at range.
text.Les monstres tapent surtout au CaC : res: Monsters hit mostly in melee: stay at range.
text.Les Écaptifs gagnent 3 PM et 100 % de do: Ecaptives gain 3 MP and 100% damage on turn 4. Hitting the Ballackey 3 times removes the resistances it gives. The Bangcutioner boosts its allies as it loses HP.
text.Libérer un Cocon en tapant l'allié enfer: Free a Cocoon by hitting the trapped ally, or the Daddy Longlex may kill them. Keep the Venomica and the Nephilady at range.
text.Lié à un personnage (une rune montre où: Linked to a character (a rune shows where it appears): while it lives, that character deals only half damage and loses 1 MP per turn. 0 AP, 0 MP: it doesn't move.
text.Lotus à 10 % PV, tuer son double: Lotus at 10% HP, kill its double
text.Lui infliger des dommages de poussée ret: Dealing her pushback damage removes Shielded Shell for 1 turn (she becomes Unmovable).
text.Lui retirer Kissiphrot le retire à tous: Removing his Kissiphrot removes it from all enemies and dismounts him for 3 turns. Gravity then stops him from swapping places. Healing removes diseases.
text.Lui retirer de la PO lui donne +50 % de: Reducing her range gives her +50% resistances for 2 turns.
text.Malheur : si un personnage touché est so: Calamity: if a hit character is healed, all those hit lose half their Vitality for 2 turns.
text.Malédiction (s'il existe une invocation: Curse (if an enemy summon exists, every 6 turns): kills all summons and removes MP from the whole team. It only summons in a line at 2 range: blocking its 4 adjacent cells prevents it.
text.Malédiction Pirate, chaque début de tour: Pirate Curse, each turn start: the closest and the Cursed (melee) get minimized damage and take Water damage. Gravity blocks his swap; alone, he's no longer dangerous. Avoid Water on him.
text.Marcher sur une congère repousse la cibl: Walking onto a snowdrift pushes the target back and makes it vulnerable: set up this move before attacking. Watch out for pushback damage on the team.
text.Martignasse échange de place, puis te ra: Braidwhip swaps places, then brings you back at end of turn (Gravity or a dispel prevents it). Her reaction skips your turn (Naissance) or swaps places (Chasse).
text.Mawtyw : tapé à distance, lui et toutes: Mawtyw: when hit at range, he and all entities within 2 cells gain 1 AP and damage for 2 turns.
text.Mets-le en Pesanteur et à 0 PM pour qu'i: Give him Gravity and 0 MP so he can't leap away from the turtles next to him.
text.Monstres et Zoeufs explosent en mourant: Monsters and Bzzeggs explode on death: stay out of the areas. The deaths of the Bzzoctor and its Bzzegg heal around them.
text.Mort Sûre marque la cible (tête de mort: Certain Death marks the target (blue skull): a second hit after the 2-turn cooldown kills it.
text.Mortier : chaque coup reçu ensuite au Ca: Mortar: each later hit taken in melee deals extra Water damage. He is resummoned if he dies while monsters are alive.
text.Morzyloeil : poison qui blesse selon les: Eye-Eye: poison that hurts per MP used.
text.N'a qu'un PM ; frappe autour de lui dans: Has only one MP; hits around itself in a 3-cell circle and gains damage each turn.
text.Ne bouge pas mais tape à portée infinie: Doesn't move but hits at infinite range: stay out of his line of sight. Summons one Pricky per turn, 5 max.
text.Ne fait mal qu'en critique : sa Cawotte: Only hurts on critical hits: his Woyal Cawwot gives him crit (+10%) and lays a glyph that heals monsters and makes you Unhealable: don't start or end your turn in it.
text.Ne fait pas de dégâts : rester hors de s: Deals no damage: stay off his lines or behind an obstacle, remove his MP or range. Breath (from turn 2, in line within 5 range) turns you into a Gobkool, dispellable. A summoned Gobkool can make him invisible and give him 5 MP.
text.Ne frappe qu'au CaC, très fort : le teni: Only hits in melee, very hard: keep him at range (MP reduction, pushes) or block him in a corner, with monsters other than the Cybwork (who takes his damage) and Mama Bwork (who heals him).
text.Ne frappe qu'au CaC. Gagne de la Vitalit: Only hits in melee. Gains Vitality when you dodge away from it.
text.Ne jamais finir au CaC du Flib : chaque: Never end your turn in melee with Ze Flib: each hit makes you skip your turn.
text.Ne jamais finir au contact d'un allié (O: Never end your turn next to an ally (one-shot).
text.Ne jamais finir son tour collé à un alli: Never end your turn next to an ally: Guerrilla hurts them. Play at range, many spells are cast in melee. The Levitos remove AP and MP and are a nuisance all fight.
text.Ne jamais lui retirer de PM : chaque ten: Never remove his MP: each attempt gives him 1 MP for the fight. Finish him in one turn around 35% HP. A Poutch boosted twice in AP kills the whole team: kill it before the recast (3 turns).
Never stay in line with a Gobshell.
text.Ne jamais taper ni tuer un monstre à 3 P: Never hit or kill a monster within 3 range of him: he wakes for 2 turns. Once his Mount is killed, he stays awake and vulnerable. Gravity blocks his teleport. Stronger below 50% HP.
text.Ne jamais être en ligne avec une Bonbomb: Never be in line with an exploding red Bonbomb (“auto-win” placement). Keep monsters at range. Keep the Bomb Ilical away from allies.
text.Ne le taper qu'au moment de le tuer en u: Only hit it when you can kill it in one turn, right after its turn: the less HP it has, the harder it hits the whole team. Tchessed only hits at 4+ range: end within 3 range, block it between 2 summons.
text.Ne le tue pas : sa mort donne +2 PM et +: Don't kill him: his death gives +2 MP and +200 Power to all his allies for 2 turns. Boolanthropy (melee, every 2 turns): if its target dies, a Boowolf appears.
Don't end in melee with the Greedovore.
text.Ne pas finir en vue de la Poulpée. Taper: Don't end in the Octodoll's line of sight. Hit the Tryde every turn to reveal it.
text.Ne pas finir son tour au contact d'un en: Don't end your turn in contact with an enemy: the Mumminotor hits every character who is.
text.Ne pas finir son tour dans le glyphe du: Don't end your turn in the Arachkin's glyph.
text.Ne pas finir son tour dans les glyphes b: Don't end your turn in the Blop's white glyphs. The Blopshroom hits hard at range.
Don't end your turn in line with him. Gains 1 MP each time he takes damage.
text.Ne pas la laisser approcher d'Ilyzaelle: Don't let her near Ilyzaelle: she would share her damage.
text.Ne pas laisser d'invocation en ligne ave: Don't leave a summon in line with a character: he hits it and pulls everyone onto it, in sight of the other monsters.
text.Ne pas le pousser : chaque poussée lui d: Don't push it: each push gives it 1 MP. The character killed by Masticate becomes a Mastogobbly.
text.Ne pas placer d'invocation près de lui :: Don't place a summon near him: his melee hit also hits the entity closest to the target.
text.Ne pas rester groupés face au Rate Atiné: Don't stay grouped facing the Shrynk Rat: it hits in an area up to 3 times per turn and heals its allies in the area.
text.Ne pas retirer de PM aux monstres sans p: Don't remove monsters' MP without protection. Never end your turn in the Bartyclank's glyph.
text.Ne pas se faire frapper au CaC deux tour: Don't let him hit you in melee two turns in a row: Reprieve heals him. Hit at range, he steps back a cell; if he can't, -50% resistance but +200 Power. Hit in melee, he doesn't move.
text.Ne pas taper la Poupée : elle tape autou: Don't hit the Doll: it hits around itself at each end of turn and gains Power. It swaps places and removes range (turn 1, then every 4 turns). He resummons it as soon as it dies.
text.Ne pas tuer son tas d'or : il devient in: Don't kill his gold pile: he turns invisible, gains MP and can take a large share of the killer's HP. The Lantern reveals him.
text.Ne peut pas tuer les Blops Royaux ni les: Can't kill Royal Blops or other Greedoblops. Each entity eaten gives him MP and Vitality.
text.Ne peut pas être poussé et réduit les dé: Can't be pushed and reduces ranged damage 2 turns out of 4.
text.Ne pose ses glyphes qu'après un coup sur: Only places glyphs after a hit on the Kimbo: odd if Earth/Water, even if Air/Fire. Stand on the other parity before its turn. It then moves 1 cell: push it an odd number of cells or end your turn on a glyph.
text.Ne subit presque rien à distance : la fr: Takes almost nothing at range: hit her in melee, then move more than 2 range away before her turn (Silent, summons killed). Don't erode her: a spell hits based on her eroded HP.
text.Ne tape qu'au CaC et a peu de PV. Invoqu: Only hits in melee and has little HP. Summons the Kardorib on turn 1, then every 6 turns: keep it at range, it hits in melee and pushes 2 cells (pushback damage into an obstacle).
text.Ne tape qu'au CaC, puis recule. Soigne s: Only hits in melee, then backs off. Heals allies up to range 6, not himself. Put a character or a summon next to him: he hits, then backs off. Avoid using a high-Lock character there.
text.Ne tape qu'en diagonale : rester en lign: Only hits diagonally: stay in line with her.
Only hits diagonally: stay in line with her. Each monster killed gives 1 MP to all monsters and big damage to Fuji and the Tengu for 1 turn. Replaces a target killed in melee with a monster.
text.Ninsipide touche toute une ligne, même d: Yoboring hits a whole line, even from afar: block him or push him out of your lines.
text.Nécronyx sur chaque monstre avant de le: Necronyx on each monster before killing it: without it they revive and reflect damage around them.
Necronyx on each monster before killing it. From turn 2, end your turn within range 6 of a monster. Push the enemy Dagon each turn so it can't pull itself in.
text.PA et PM en zone: AP and MP in an area
text.PA et PM à PO infinie: AP and MP at infinite range
text.PM et PO à toute l'équipe: MP and range from the whole team
text.PM si on lui en retire: MP if you remove its MP
text.PM à tous autour, si frappé: MP to all around, if hit
text.PM à tous si frappé au CaC: MP from all if hit in melee
text.Pacifiste en ligne de sa cible: Pacifist in line with its target
text.Par ici attire l'équipe en croix ; au to: Over Ear pulls the team in a cross; next turn it hits hard in an area around it. Once started, kill it in one turn.
text.Partage Épineux : partage ses dégâts ave: Thorny Sharing: shares its damage with an ally in line and gains Vitality with each hit taken.
text.Pas de difficulté particulière selon le: No particular difficulty per the guide. The Famished Sunflower heals allies around it and summons a dungeon monster every 6 turns.
text.Peu de PV, pas d'invulnérabilité. Au tou: Low HP, no invulnerability. On the turn after Memento Mori, he teleports onto the target, hits it and makes it unhealable: protect it. Healing a character removes Black Plague.
text.Peut donner à un allié un état qui le so: Can give an ally a state that heals it a lot when hit with an element it resists.
text.Peut pousser ou échanger un personnage s: Can push or swap a character onto a Snailmet Slobber or a Disciple's glyph.
text.Peut servir d'appât : le laisser bas en: Can be used as bait: leave him low on HP so the Bworkette uses her Regeneration on him.
text.Pique-Couic : se détacler partiellement: Snap'n'stab: a partial dodge then minimizes your rolls.
text.Placement critique : commencer son tour: Critical positioning: starting your turn on a Snailmet Slobber kills. The Snailmet and Air Pikoko swap or push to put you there.
text.Pose une interception sur un personnage: Places an interception on a character: they take the damage dealt to the monsters instead. Steals life.
text.Pousser sans dommages de poussée le rend: Pushing him without pushback damage makes him vulnerable until the next turn (+4 MP). Pushback damage on him, even via an ally pushed into him, kills those in line with him. Each summon gives him a bonus, its death a penalty.
text.Pousser un ennemi (congère ou sort) le r: Pushing an enemy (snowdrift or spell) makes it vulnerable for 1 turn but heals it. Avoid being next to monsters at turn start.
text.Poussé ou attiré, il rend Affaiblis (pas: When pushed or pulled, he makes characters on his diagonal Weakened (no weapon).
text.Prend l'apparence d'un allié et tape dan: Takes the appearance of an ally and hits in its element.
text.Protéger des dégâts Terre et Neutre les: Protect characters under KilleRat from Earth and Neutral damage. Don't heal a character under Black Plague. Don't hit a monster under Korrattion with Earth or Neutral.
text.Présent en butin 5 ou plus. Son cadeau C: Present at loot 5 or more. Its Prez' Plozion gift, summoned 1 cell away, kills characters within 2 cells.
text.Présente dans la fosse du cachot seuleme: Only in the dungeon pit during the Low Crackler Mountain invasion. No need to fight her: climb back up the ladder.
text.Pus des Pieds : poison qui blesse selon: Foul Feet: poison that hurts per MP used. Dodges some melee hits by moving back.
text.Pépite si tapé dans son élément: Nugget if hit in its element
text.Quand un monstre meurt, elle gagne de gr: When a monster dies, it gains heavy Damage and 1 MP, the other monsters 1 MP: back off before killing. Its attack only goes diagonally, at 3 to 4 range.
text.Rascasse (2 tours) : chaque coup lui don: Sprat (2 turns): each hit gives him 50% resistance in the element used. Dispelling him resets his resistances. Under White Plague, being healed removes all your boosts.
text.Reconstitution inutile au-dessus de 80 %: Regeneration is useless above 80%: waste it at 82%, erode him, reduce his heals. 1st hit per character halved; +30 Power per hit taken. Killed summons: Boowolves.
text.Reflets placides : le personnage marqué: Toe Busker: the marked character must be the first to hit it before its turn, or they die. Killing it also cancels the effect.
text.Rend toute l'équipe Insoignable 1 tour :: Makes the whole team Unhealable for 1 turn: don't count on heals. Hits in melee in all 4 elements, stealing HP and MP: keep MP to move away. Boosts its allies' damage.
text.Renvoie les dégâts tant que ses 3 puces: Reflects damage until his 3 fleas share the same state (I, II, III), except poisons and the killing blow. Hitting a flea from its contact cell raises its state and lowers the other two.
text.Ressuscite dès le tour 3 un monstre à 1: From turn 3, revives a monster at 1% HP, Invulnerable for 1 turn (dispellable). Pesty Side: the target sends half the damage taken to nearby allies.
text.Ressuscite le dernier monstre mort avec: Revives the last dead monster with 10% of its HP, every 2 turns. If it dies, the revived monster dies too.
text.Rester hors de portée des Flammèches des: Stay out of range of the Elemental Bworks' Sparks, which pull and explode in melee.
text.Rester hors de sa ligne. Placer les pers: Stay out of his line. Put fragile characters at the back of the map and remove his MP and range. With no one in line, he hits Earth at range and removes AP.
text.Rester hors de vue des monstres ou à 4 P: Stay out of the monsters' sight or within 4 range.
text.Rester loin des monstres, dangereux surt: Stay away from the monsters, most dangerous in melee. Avoid summoning: the Curse of the Mumminotor kills summons and removes MP from the whole team.
text.Rester sous 90 % PV avant de tuer un mon: Stay under 90% HP before killing a resummoned monster. Place the zombie 6 to 10 cells from him and move away from its blast before finishing it.
text.Rester sous 90 % PV. Un monstre tué revi: Stay under 90% HP. A killed monster returns as a Zombie: move away before finishing it (it explodes). Finishing the first resummoned one kills the whole chain.
text.Rester à 2 PO ou moins au début de son t: Stay within 2 range at the start of its turn: farther, Pacifist; at 3 range, the state is removed. It heals for each character or summon farther than 2 range.
Stay within 2 range at the start of its turn: farther, Pacifist; at 3 range, the state is removed. It heals for each character or summon beyond 2 range.
text.Rester à distance des monstres et de leu: Stay away from the monsters and their summons.
text.Rester à moins de 8 PO de lui : en fin d: Stay within 8 range of him: at the end of a character's turn, monsters over 8 range from that character gain 1 MP and a shield. Any entity pushed or pulled leaves a red glyph under it.
text.Rester à plus de 7 PO au début de son to: Stay beyond 7 range at the start of its turn to avoid its melee hit. From turn 3, it buffs itself, heals and reflects damage.
text.Retire beaucoup de PM en zone. Ses Image: Removes a lot of MP in an area. Her Mirror Images are summoned again as soon as they die. Pushes back 6 cells in a line (pushback damage).
text.Retirer PA, PM ou PO donne 10 Esquive PA: Removing AP, MP or range gives the targeted monster 10 AP and MP Parry. A dying entity leaves a Carrion, which heals a monster starting its turn within range 4 of it.
text.Retirer de la PO au Cocholou limite ses: Removing range from the Boopig limits its actions. The Boowoldlum, Unshakable 2 turns out of 4, can't be pushed.
text.Retour de Chachaton met la cible dans l': Kikitty Payback puts the target in the “You're the Kikitty!” state for 1 turn: it reflects melee damage taken. Gives itself a shield by hitting around it.
text.Rip au CaC si poussée bloquée: Rip in melee if push blocked
text.Rip bloqué par un obstacle retire 99 % d: Rip blocked by an obstacle removes 99% HP and turns the target into a Pile of Bones.
text.Réduit de 50 % les dégâts au CaC : le ta: Reduces melee damage by 50%: hit him at range. Jufang locks his target in his melee (Gravity, Unmovable). At 50 and 25% HP: +4 MP for 2 turns, and +20% melee damage at the 2nd threshold.
text.Réduit les dégâts subis au CaC et à l'ar: Takes less damage in melee and from weapons: hit him at range with spells. He reveals invisible characters within 3 range of a character he marks.
text.Réinvoque les Marionnettes dès le tour 5: Resummons the Puppets from turn 5, then every 4 turns. Bunraku: hit the targeted ally, or a Little Puppet (copy of its stats) appears next to it.
text.Réinvoque ses Grokillages tous les 5 tou: Resummons her Colosshells every 5 turns. Killing her kills all Colosshells for good.
text.Répartit la moitié des dégâts qu'il subi: Spreads half the damage it takes to everyone within 2 range of it. Hitting it costs the attacker and those near them AP (Water), effect duration (Fire) or Power (Air).
text.S'il a encore Kissiphrot, taper un allié: If he still has Kissiphrot, hitting an ally he protects still gives the poison.
text.S'il devient un Scarafeuille déjà mort,: If it becomes an already-dead Scaraleaf, the Golden Scarabugly regains the lost resistance. Its Unlockable on the boss can be dispelled.
text.Sa Bouteille de Pandabsynthe (tours impa: Its Bottle of Pandabsinthe (odd turns) gives it 80% resistances: kill it the turn it appears and it can be hit on the even turn. Blocking the cells around it prevents the summon.
text.Sa Flammèche attire de 4 cases puis expl: His Spark pulls 4 cells then explodes in melee: kill it fast or stay out of its range.
text.8 PA au départ, +1 PA par tour : le dése: 8 AP at the start, +1 AP per turn: dispel him. At 12 AP, he casts Dazing Stone, which removes 100 AP from the whole team. His Whack also hits his allies around the target.
text.Sa Pitraille explose à 4 cases autour d': Her Ectobomb explodes within 4 cells when hit: leave it alone and move away.
text.Sa cible soigne le monstre le plus proch: Its target heals the nearest monster with each move, not each MP: move in one go.
text.Sa mort donne de gros dommages au Scarab: Its death deals big damage to the Golden Scarabugly.
text.Sa mort et celle de son Zoeuf soignent a: His death and his Bzzegg's heal around them: finish them away from the monsters.
text.Sabotage repousse de 6 cases : les dégât: Hoofbeat pushes back 6 cells: pushback damage is added if an obstacle is behind. Can boost its summons' Vitality and damage.
text.Salle 3 : les monstres sont invulnérable: Room 3: monsters are invulnerable at range while he lives. Room 4: he doubles all monsters' HP.
text.Sangsuc (tout le combat) : érosion et vo: Bloodsucker (whole fight): Erosion and lifesteal at each turn end. Ending your turn in melee with a monster heals it, or shields it if at full HP.
text.Se booste en Puissance par Cactruc en je: Boosts his Power for each Casthing in play. A Casthing that is hit strikes those next to it, and Cucaractus hits those touching a Casthing: don't stay next to Casthings.
text.Se disperser : les Grand Pa Wabbit tapen: Spread out: the Gwandpa Wabbits hit and hinder in a 2-cell circle.
text.Se placer sur ses glyphes de Crystalisat: Stand on his Crystallisation glyphs (shield), diagonally: at the start of his turn, he hits characters aligned within 5 range of an entity on a glyph. All characters gain final damage each turn.
text.Se téléporte à chaque coup reçu : la Pes: Teleports each time he's hit: Gravity prevents it.
text.Ses 4 Totems (500 PV) reviennent au tour: His 4 Totems (500 HP) return on turn 6, then every 5 turns: killing them prevents swaps and black glyphs until then. Hitting a Totem in line with its element pulls it. At turn end, you swap with the nearest Totem (black glyph).
text.Ses Tamponneurs (150 % rés.) renvoient d: Its Stamper Wobots (150% res.) send anything pushed onto them back 6 cells: two in line within 5 cells make it bounce until it dies. Don't end your turn next to them. +30% res. on turn 3, then every 5 turns.
text.Ses Tofus Fugaces meurent seuls à la fin: Its Fleeting Tofus die on their own at the end of their 2nd turn.
text.Ses coups laissent un poison indébuffabl: His hits leave an undispellable poison that strikes one or two turns later.
text.Ses doubles meurent avec lui : chercher: His doubles die with him: find the real Buddy Dubble. His 7-range glyph makes his allies invisible and Unlockable for 2 turns.
text.Ses pièges (2 par tour) immobilisent 2 t: Her traps (2 per turn) immobilise for 2 turns; she then pulls herself to the trapped character and hits very hard. Move as little as possible.
text.Ses pièges d'une case attirent tous tes: Its one-cell traps pull all your characters 3 cells and reveal the black glyph: whoever starts or ends their turn in it dies. Keep 3 MP to get out.
text.Ses résistances données se retirent en t: The resistances it gives are removed by hitting the Ballackey 3 times.
text.Ses sorts changent selon ses PV au début: His spells change with his HP at the start of his turn. Below 40% HP, he kills a target under Acidic Evacuation in melee. All his spells cost 3 AP: bring him down to 2 AP. Gravity stops him teleporting.
text.Ses sorts sont à PO modifiable : lui ret: Her spells have modifiable range: removing her range greatly reduces her effectiveness.
text.Ses tours 2, 5, 8… : Pacifiste à 6 PO ou: Her turns 2, 5, 8…: Pacifist within 6 range of her, and effect durations shortened at 7 range or more. Her ranged damage taken is slightly reduced.
text.Ses tours impairs, finir à plus de 3 PO: On her odd turns, end more than 3 range from every monster (glyphs); on her even turns, exactly 3 range from a monster. Glyphs and traps barely hurt her.
text.Sfvc%$*$R ? (relance 3 tours, dès le tou: Sfvc%$*$R? (3-turn cooldown, from turn 2): at random, he turns invisible, teleports or summons a zone monster up to 6 range.
text.Si elle te tape au CaC, tu ne peux plus: If she hits you in melee, you can no longer attack in melee (Weakened state). Unsummons summons adjacent to her.
text.Silhouette au glyphe, lui hors: Silhouette in the glyph, him out
text.Soigne ses alliés de 10 % de leurs PV à: Heals its allies for 10% of their HP each turn (20% for the Crocabulia). Dies on its own after 4 turns; killed earlier, it hits Fire and applies Unhealable in an 8-cell circle: finish it from beyond 8 range.
text.Soigner un allié au CaC d'un monstre lui: Healing an ally in melee with a monster removes its Kissiphrot; otherwise each hit gives a big poison. Remove diseases with 3 heals or lifesteal.
text.Soigner un allié collé à lui le rend vul: Healing an ally next to him makes him vulnerable for 6 turns; he turns invulnerable again if the healed ally dies. Pushing or pulling him lets you heal from the damage you deal him for 1 turn.
text.Son Auroraire règle les dégâts de tous :: His Aurour sets everyone's damage: low until the 5th hour, high from the 6th to the 11th; kill him before the 12th hour. When moved, he swaps with an ally: give him Gravity. His death removes the Aurour.
text.Son Malterego donne 3 PA contre un poiso: His Malterego gives 3 AP for one poison per AP used: use few or kill the Malterego before the turn ends. Gravity or Rooted to block him.
text.Son attaque en ligne ignore la ligne de: Its line attack ignores line of sight: don't line up with it, even behind an obstacle.
text.Son glyphe traverse la carte : selon sa: His glyph crosses the map: depending on its color, it boosts everyone, himself or the characters inside. The Lantern changes its direction.
text.Son géoglyphe grandit à chaque phase (ca: His geoglyph grows each phase (7x7 square, checkerboard, infinite star). Pushing him to the next phase before his turn prevents his heal.
text.Son invisibilité n'est lançable qu'à par: Its invisibility can only be cast from turn 2.
text.Son invocation reste invulnérable tout l: Its summon stays invulnerable the whole fight: keep away from Boorlou (Gravity and MP removal within 3 range) and Brawlgheera (melee hits). Boofree is not dangerous.
text.Son poison inflige des dégâts par PA uti: Its poison deals damage per AP used: avoid acting while it's active.
text.Son poison à distance frappe en fin de t: Its ranged poison hits at end of turn based on AP used.
text.Son renvoi ne s'applique pas aux coups p: His reflect doesn't apply to melee hits.
text.Son sacrifice sur le Roi au tour 2 gêne: His sacrifice on the King on turn 2 is a big problem: keep him away from him.
text.Sortir du glyphe rouge avant la fin du t: Leave the red glyph before turn end: Gravity prevents teleporting, an MP gain or an Abyssal Dofus helps.
text.Sortir un monstre de ce glyphe avant de: Move a monster out of this glyph before hitting it. Its other glyphs give 2 AP or heal whoever ends their turn on them.
text.Sous 50 % PV en début de tour, il devien: Below 50% HP at the start of his turn, he turns invisible, then heals and gains a shield: stop him around 55-60% HP or make him Unhealable. Walking on a blue glyph reveals the Kitsounebi.
text.Sous 50 % PV, chaque ligne de dégâts lui: Under 50% HP, each damage line gives it Vitality: finish it with big single-line hits. Dispelling this bonus can kill it.
text.Sous 75 % et 50 % PV, passe dans votre c: Below 75% and 50% HP, joins your side for 2 turns (invulnerable, her glyph boosts your damage and kills monsters); the 2nd time, surviving wins the fight. Obstacle on turns 3, 6, 9. No healing or Erosion; 250 Critical Res.
text.Sous Brûlis, le frapper au CaC te vole d: Under Slash and Burn, hitting it in melee steals your HP. Also poisons with Fire.
text.Sous Escamotage, lui et ses voisins esqu: Under Retraction, it and its neighbors dodge melee hits and gain damage on every hit taken.
text.Sous Frostiz, le frapper au CaC retire 1: Under Frosteez, hitting it in melee removes 100 MP from the whole team for 1 turn.
text.Sous Glours poursuite, le frapper attire: Under Bearbarhop, hitting it pulls everything in line with it: don't hit it while it's aligned with the Celestial Bearbarian. Its AoE also hits its allies.
text.Sous Hel, utiliser peu de PM (dégâts par: Under Hel, use little MP (damage per MP used); dispel if possible. Stay at range and remove its range. Avoid walls: pushback deals heavy damage.
text.Sous Nowel, chaque coup reçu frappe tout: Under Ka-blooey, each hit taken strikes everything in melee with it: don't hit it if an ally is there.
text.Sous Retour historique, chaque coup reçu: Under Historic Return, each hit taken sends the attacker back to their previous position; a telefrag deals heavy Water damage.
text.Sous Shatte, chaque coup reçu lui donne: Under Tanning, each hit taken gives it a random bonus (AP, MP, damage, critical or heal).
text.Sous Solfasoin, le frapper soigne ses al: Under Sulpheeling Better, hitting it heals its allies in a 3-cell circle around it.
text.jusqu'à Sporakne sur un glyphe: until Sporachnee is on a glyph
text.Subterfuge : invisible 1 tour, empoisonn: Subterfuge: invisible for 1 turn, poisons adjacent targets based on its missing HP.
text.Sur un personnage en Brûlure : le renvoi: On a character in Burn: sends them back to their turn-start cell and raises their damage taken for 2 turns.
text.Surgelé : Sang froid tape plus: Deep Freeze: Cold Blood hits harder
text.Surveiller la Folie : chaque coup direct: Watch your Madness: each direct hit swaps places, prefer poisons and single-line spells. Hitting an ally removes one Madness from them.
text.Séparer les gobelins : chacun gagne des: Separate the goblins: each gains damage per nearby goblin at the start of its turn. Stay at range: only the Goballista hits from afar.
text.Tact : le taper soigne tout ce qui est à: Tact: hitting it heals everything within 2 cells of it for double the damage taken.
text.Tactique A à D à chaque tour: Tactic A to D each turn
text.Tant que des monstres vivent, finir son: While monsters are alive, end your turn in sight of an enemy to avoid Cauchemar.
text.Tape toute l'équipe tous les 2 tours (po: Hits the whole team every 2 turns (poison per MP used) and his melee at every turn start. The monster under Paternalism takes half damage and is healed. Each dead monster heals him but removes some of his resistances.
text.Taper avec une arme au CaC le booste en: Hitting him with a weapon in melee boosts his Power and reflects part of the damage around him.
text.Taper la bonne illusion les fait toutes: Hitting the right illusion makes them all vanish.
text.Taper le Pantin jusqu'à 10 % PV : le per: Hit the Marionette down to 10% HP: the nearest character controls it and casts Unravelling on the Dramak (2 range) to make him vulnerable for 2 turns.
text.Taper les Krobes blesse la Malamibe : la: Hitting the Krobes hurts the Malamoeba: kill it within 2 full turns. Each Krobe dies after 3 turns of its condition.
text.Taper un seul monstre à la fois : les au: Hit only one monster at a time: the others advance toward the attacker.
text.Taper un Éclat Kao donne Chocolathée : l: Hitting a Chokao Chip gives Chocolathiest: finishing it in one hit, with poison or a bomb avoids it.
text.Taper une illusion la fait disparaître,: Hitting an illusion makes it vanish; hitting the real one makes them all vanish: AoE spells, end-of-turn poison from turn 1, or Gravity.
text.Tapé au CaC, il repousse l'attaquant de: Hit in melee, he pushes the attacker back 3 cells. The Wa Wobot turns his Cawwot into a Stamper Wobot.
text.Tapé en ligne, il fonce sur l'attaquant,: Hit in line, he charges the attacker, hits around him and gains 10% final damage, up to 10 times per turn, off-line hits included: let a tank hit him in line. Toromatic stacks: keep him away from his allies.
text.Tapé, il change en Boufcool les entités: When hit, he turns entities in line (even turn) or diagonal (odd turn) into Boufcools. A Boufcool starting its turn 2 cells from him removes 20% of his resistances: line up summons there, hit him once. 0 pushback res.
text.Toile, glyphe qui retire les PM: Web, a glyph that removes MP
text.Totems : rouge Feu, vert Air, bleu Eau,: Totems: red Fire, green Air, blue Water, yellow Earth, each with a glyph of its colour. Hitting a totem in line with its element pulls it next to you. Hitting Darkli Moon swaps your place with him.
text.Tour 1 : Étourderie Mortelle empoisonne: Turn 1: Lethal Blunder poisons all characters for 2 turns. Wait without using AP or dispel yourself. Keep him away with MP removal. Pushes into obstacles: extra damage.
text.Tour impair : le frapper fait tourner de: Odd turn: hitting him rotates you 180° around him; even turn, he moves. Impossible landing cell: the team dies. Swap with an allied summon: allies within 3 cells die. Vulnerable: Gravity stops his teleports.
text.Tours impairs : +3 PO et attire de 2 les: Odd turns: +3 range and pulls enemies within 7 cells by 2; even turns: pushes them back 2. Tsukuyomi gains damage each turn.
text.Tours impairs, il esquive tout au CaC ;: Odd turns, he dodges everything in melee; even turns, invulnerable at range. Each hit, push or removal gives the monsters a bonus and your characters a penalty: hit hard in a single line.
text.Tous les 1 à 3 tours, les persos proches: Every 1 to 3 turns, characters near it take maximum-roll hits. Stay apart: each character hit buffs its Power and damage reduction.
