text.Tous les 2 tours, il invoque un Nufor qu: Every 2 turns, he summons a Nufor that summons 4, then 8 more around it. Each Nufor in sight repeats his Aggressive Rhizome (Fire area, -2 MP): killing the first Nufor as soon as it is summoned stops the spread.
text.Tous les 4 tours, se met sur le dos 2 to: Every 4 turns, rolls on his back for 2 turns: immobile, takes more damage and places a 3x3 glyph that hits, removes MP and applies Gravity to whoever starts their turn in it.
text.Tous les ennemis sont invulnérables tant: All enemies are invulnerable while the 8 fires burn. A blue Founoroshi glyph gives “Fire Extinction”; the brown cell right of a fire puts it out. Once vulnerable, they stay so.
text.Tous les monstres invoquent des Bombombr: All monsters summon Cucumbombs, whose glyph hits. Keep a Water Cucumbomb alive: it's used to reach Nagate.
text.Tous ses sorts retirent ou volent de la: All its spells remove or steal range: stay close to it. +50% Critical on turns 4, 7, 10…
text.Tout dommage de poussée tue. Sous leur é: Any pushback damage kills. Under their state, hitting the Rampant Bearbarian pulls whatever is in line with it, and the Esurient Bearbarian gains pushback damage.
Every entity becomes a Pile of Bones at 1% HP. Put enemy Piles of Bones in the black glyphs (hitting them pulls them): once all are placed, the fight is won. An allied Pile of Bones placed in a glyph comes back.
text.Toute tentative de retrait PM lui donne: Any MP removal attempt gives it MP, Power and Pushback Damage: don't remove its MP. Only hits in melee.
text.Traître : finir son tour sur un glyphe b: Traitorous: end your turn on a white glyph, +1 per hit on an ally (5 max); each hit on Servitude uses one. Unhealable before 1 HP prevents her heal.
Traitorous: end your turn on a white glyph, +1 per hit on an ally (5 max); each hit on Servitude uses one. At 1 HP, sends everyone back to start and heals 25%, unless Unhealable.
text.Tue les invocations dans un cercle de 2: Kills summons within a 2-cell circle around him.
text.Tue toutes les invocations du terrain to: Kills all summons on the map every 6 turns. Its Jellidices give a random boost to all enemies.
text.Tuer le Monolithe (invulnérable à distan: Killing the Monolith (invulnerable at range) brings the Dagon to your side: only it can hit Bethel, in melee. Necronyx on Bethel from turn 1, recast every 3 turns; without it he pushes back.
text.Tuer sa vague le met à terre 2 tours : a: Killing his wave knocks him down for 2 turns: reach his threshold, or he hits the whole team when he wakes. Paw strikes show a red glyph first: don't end in it (one-shot). Stay on the sides: Beastly Barrage pulls you to the middle.
text.Tué, il revient dans votre camp sous le: Killed, it comes back on your side, controlled by its killer. Its Antiks doubles the damage reflected onto the Sponge Mob. If it dies again, the killing monster controls it.
text.Tuée, elle donne à l'équipe 1 PA, 1 PM,: Killed, it gives the team 1 AP, 1 MP, 2 range, 20% resistances and a 4,000 shield every 3 turns; killing one Gorgoyle is enough to control the fight. Low HP.
Killed, it gives the team 1 AP, 1 MP, 2 range, 200% vitality and 200% final damage; killing one Gorgoyle is enough to control the fight. Lots of HP and 12 MP: hard to keep at range.
Killed, it gives the team 1 AP, 1 MP, 2 range, 500 pushback resistance and a 10% HP heal every 2 turns; killing one Gorgoyle is enough to control the fight. It has 75% ranged resistance.
text.Un Cocon se retire en tapant l'allié une: Remove a Cocoon by hitting the ally once with a weak spell. Killing the Web removes its glyph. Stay far and out of her lines.
text.Un Scarafeuille Immature devient en 2 to: An Immature Scaraleaf becomes a random Scaraleaf in 2 turns, which can restore a lost resistance to the Golden Scarabugly. Killing the Black Scaraleaf deals big damage to the Golden Scarabugly.
text.Un Scarafeuille mort lui retire 50 % de: A dead Scaraleaf removes 50% of his resistance in its element (White Air, Green Earth, Blue Water, Red Fire), boosts him and leaves a Spark that hits hard around it: kill only 1 or 2.
text.Un coup critique ou une arme, avec un pe: A critical hit or a weapon hit, with a character in melee with her, makes her vulnerable for 2 turns. Her allies stay invulnerable while she lives. Avoid it during While You're Tank It (shield).
text.Un coup ne le touche qu'en alternant : e: A hit only lands by alternating: in Red state hit him in melee, in Black state from range. Each hit taken switches his state. Good Lock.
text.Un glyphe apparaît où meurt un combattan: A glyph appears where a fighter dies: stepping on it gives Chocomatose (AP and Power) but monsters can then teleport into your melee. The glyphs vanish when the Mawabouwaino dies.
text.Un monstre qui meurt frappe les personna: A dying monster hits characters in its line of sight: break it before finishing it off. The brown glyph placed at the start of your turn heals you if you end in it.
text.Un monstre qui ne touche aucun personnag: A monster that hits no character gains Stubbygerness, up to 3: letting it hit a character stops it rising. Avoid the Gobyob's lines.
text.Un personnage qui subit des dommages de: A character taking pushback damage is pushed back 6 cells, along with those next to them. It swaps places with whoever hits it, on each damage line.
text.Un personnage sur une rune en fin de tou: A character on a rune at end of turn blocks that Arm and controls all Arms. They hit Neutral: each Neutral hit removes 5% Neutral resistance from him. Put him in an Arm's range. Killing an Arm prevents the 5th.
text.Un seul déplacement par tour sur lui et: Only one move per turn on him and on the Silhouette, which flees after hitting: let it end in the glyph. The invulnerable Globilum moves one cell per turn and hits whatever is far from it.
text.Un tour sur deux (Kirbili), chaque coup: Every other turn (Kirbili), each hit on a monster gives him damage but heals characters near him. His death strengthens the Kolosso.
text.Une arme tuée après le tour de Guerre lu: A weapon killed after War's turn gives her resistances, MP and heals. Fearless is cast up to range 3: staying farther avoids it. In Fearless state, the others turn Pacifist by hitting her.
text.Une ligne de dégâts depuis le glyphe ble: A damage line from the blue glyph makes the target vulnerable for your turn. Don't kill a monster during Full Moon or Waxing Crescent: the others keep the bonus. Once Turtelonia dies, everything turns vulnerable.
text.Une tentative de retrait PM le rend vuln: An MP removal attempt makes it vulnerable for 1 turn but gives it +63 range: all its spells, including its heavy melee hit, then reach in a line. Hit by Sentence: no heals for 2 turns.
text.Une vague tous les 5 tours. Retirer des: A wave every 5 turns. Remove the monsters' MP and keep them away from the Catseye, or in Gravity, so he can't swap with them. Soldiers of Fortune hit from range.
text.Ton double te renvoie les dégâts qu'il s: Your double reflects the damage it takes onto you and adds Madness when it plays: kill it by pushing it into a monster.
text.Vulnérable 1 tour : le tuer dans ce tour: Vulnerable for 1 turn: kill him that turn. Hit him Water, Fire, Earth then Air to summon the 4 tentacles, which make him vulnerable. Don't dispel him.
text.Vulnérable 1 tour si 3 personnages finis: Vulnerable for 1 turn if 3 characters end their turn on its blue glyphs (2 if an ally is dead, 1 if two are). Do not put it in Gravity: it stops placing its glyphs and turns Invulnerable again.
text.Vulnérable dès le tour 3, il lance Cuir: Vulnerable from turn 3, he casts Simmer: he and his allies return to their turn-start cell with Lock and Damage; a character on that cell swaps places and loses 6 MP. Finish him fast.
text.Vulnérable seulement à 2 PO : y entrer p: Only vulnerable at range 2: step in to hit him, step out before his turn. One-shots the whole team on turn 25. Unmovable: play around his AI with a tank. Below 80% HP, he heals per enemy out of his sight.
text.Vulnérable, il ne cible que sa Boule Pua: When vulnerable, it only targets its Stink Bomb: do not stand in line with it (pushback, Gravity) or next to the Stink Pellets. Keep Khepricorn and its Stink Bomb within 10 range of each other.
text.Vulnérable, il se téléporte chaque tour: When vulnerable, he teleports each turn onto the closest character and summons a clone that explodes after 2 turns. He also hatches the Bzzeggs.
text.Vulnérable, le jouer à distance, hors de: Vulnerable, play him at range, out of his lines. Revives each killed monster; killed twice at the same Aurour hour, it stays dead (yellow star). Clockrock (3 turns): move away from the Aurour. A heal removes his poison.

text.À chaque seuil, invulnérable 5 tours et: At each threshold, invulnerable for 5 turns and fully heals; Queen Amirukam helps you for 5 turns: clear thresholds fast. His glyph kills ink monsters still inside when he wakes. Gravity blocks his leap.

At each threshold, invulnerable for 5 turns and fully heals; King Imagami helps you for 5 turns: clear thresholds fast. Her glyph kills paper monsters still inside when she wakes. Stay off her lines and diagonals.
text.À partir du tour 3, rester loin de lui e: From turn 3, stay far from it and its monsters: it pulls and swaps places with a monster to hit in melee. Each turn it is hit, it gains characteristics.
text.À sa mort, il remet tous ses alliés à le: On his death, he restores all his allies to full HP and boosts their Power for the rest of the fight.
text.Éloigner le Buveur de ses alliés : il le: Keep the Drinker away from his allies: he gives them resistances. Avoid the Tamed Crobak's line.
text.Érode : ceux invoqués par le Batofu vale: Erodes: those summoned by the Batofu are worth killing if the fight drags on.
Erodes: kill it if the fight drags on.
text.Éruption en fin de tour : dégâts Feu aut: Eruption at turn end: Fire damage around it, stronger the fewer spells it cast that turn.
text.Éternuement Collatéral (au CaC) : le per: Collateral Sneeze (melee): the character hit takes all damage dealt to Thierry for 1 turn. Dispel Thierry, not the character.
text.Éviter de frapper un monstre sous Radice: Avoid hitting a monster under Rootlet: the boost repeats with each hit.
text.à 1 PV, récupère tous ses PV: at 1 HP, recovers all its HP

text.à 3 PO, sans ligne de vue: within 3 range, no line of sight

text.à distance, sur ceux à 4 PO: at range, on those within 4 range
text.échange de place si on y entre: swaps places if you step in
text.éviter : centre du glyphe blanc: avoid: center of the white glyph
text.Chaque tour, tous les monstres gagnent l: Each turn, every monster gets the current phase's bonus. Killing a monster gives that bonus to the others for the rest of the fight.
text.Nouvelle lune : frapper un monstre renvo: New Moon: hitting a monster reflects 20% of the damage onto allies within 2 cells of you; killing a monster heals the others.
text.Premier croissant : les monstres subisse: Waxing Crescent: monsters take 20% less damage.
text.Pleine lune : renvoie 200 dommages ; tue: Full Moon: reflects 200 damage; killing a monster heals the others.
text.Ne pas tuer de monstre en Pleine lune (s: Don't kill a monster during Full Moon (above all) or Waxing Crescent.
text.Le Sphincter Cell a 200 % de résistances: Sphincter Cell has 200% resistance everywhere: his Turtles remove it, one colour per element.
text.Rouge : Feu ; jaune : Air ; verte : Terr: Red: Fire; yellow: Air; green: Earth; blue: Water.
text.Une Tortue au contact du Cell, avec un p: A Turtle next to the Cell, with a character next to it: on its turn, -200% resistance in its element to the Cell and that character, 2 turns.
text.Sans personnage au contact de la Tortue,: With no character next to the Turtle, nothing happens.
text.Le Cell bondit : le mettre en Pesanteur: The Cell leaps: give him Gravity and 0 MP, and the Turtle 0 MP.
text.Tuer d'abord le Rat Noir et le Rat Blanc: Kill the Black Rat and the White Rat first, and the Turtles of elements you don't hit.
text.Quatre Tynrils, 200 % de résistances sau: Four Tynrils, 200% resistance except in their element; they only hit in melee, in that element.
text.Perfide : Feu ; Déconcerté : Eau ; Const: Perfidious: Fire; Disconcerted: Water; Dismayed: Air; Stunned: Earth.
text.Chacun met -2000 % de résistance dans so: Each gives the nearest character -2000% resistance in its element: its melee hit then kills them.
text.Deux Tynrils au contact l'un de l'autre: Two Tynrils next to each other heal.
text.À chaque tour, un Tynril échange de plac: Each turn, a Tynril swaps places with another one.
text.Placer les personnages importants loin d: Keep key characters far from them, remove MP, push them back.
text.900 % de résistances : le frapper dans u: 900% resistance: hitting him in an element summons that element's Tentacle next turn. The four make him vulnerable for 1 turn.
text.Tour 4, Air : Primaire, en dernier (OS a: Turn 4, Air: First, last (one-shots in melee, except on its 1st turn).
text.Bloquer les trois autres autour d'une in: Lock the other three around a protected summon: all three must hit it the same turn without killing it.
text.Placer le Primaire devant le Kralamoure: Put the First in front of the Kralove (it blocks his sight) and make it kill a hidden summon, 2 turns in a row.
text.Le Kralamoure perd alors ses résistances: The Kralove then loses his resistance for 1 turn but everything hits very hard: kill him that turn, or put the First back in front of him.
text.Ne pas le désenvoûter : il reprend ses r: Don't dispel him: he gets his resistance back.
text.Tous les 4 tours (tours 1, 5, 9…), un mo: Every 4 turns (turns 1, 5, 9…), a monster summons a Shell: it buffs its allies each turn and dies on its own after 4 turns.
text.Brutale : +10 % de dommages finaux (20 %: Brutal: +10% final damage (20% to the Crocabulia). Killed earlier: hits Earth, -20% final damage.
text.Protectrice : bouclier (double pour la C: Protective: shield (double for the Crocabulia). Killed earlier: hits Water, +20% damage taken.
text.Soigneuse : soigne de 10 % des PV (20 %: Healing: heals 10% HP (20% for the Crocabulia). Killed earlier: hits Fire, Unhealable.
text.Véloce : +2 PM (4 à la Crocabulia). Tuée: Swift: +2 MP (4 to the Crocabulia). Killed earlier: hits Air, -4 MP.
text.Le malus touche dans un cercle de 8 auto: The malus hits within 8 cells of it, stronger and longer if it dies early: finish it from more than 8 range, or let it die.
text.Grozilla met Tyrannisé, Grasmera met Mét: Grozilla applies Tyrannised, Grasmera applies Meteoroid: each punishes the state the other applied.
text.Tyrannisation (Grozilla, au CaC) met Tyr: Tyrannisation (Grozilla, melee) applies Tyrannised; on a Meteoroid target, also removes 50% of its current HP.
text.Météore (Grasmera, jusqu'à 4 PO) met Mét: Meteor (Grasmera, up to 4 range) applies Meteoroid; on a Tyrannised target, also removes 50% of its current HP.
text.Gravité (Grozilla) attire de 4 cases ; s: Gravity (Grozilla) pulls 4 cells; on a Meteoroid target, cancels its next turn.
text.Magnétisme (Grasmera) l'attire de 4 case: Magnetism (Grasmera) pulls her 4 cells to you; on a Tyrannised target, cancels its next turn.
text.Niveau 190 seulement : celui qui survit: Level 190 only: whichever outlives the other one-shots a character each turn: kill both in the same round.
text.Niveau 190 seulement : aux tours 6, 11,: Level 190 only: on turns 6, 11, 16…, Grozilla must start his turn within 2 range of Grasmera, or Apocalypse one-shots the whole team.
text.Après 5 attaques subies, chaque monstre: After taking 5 attacks, each monster triggers an effect based on the season. The Hunting Altar replays it, weakened, at end of turn.
text.Naissances : Ébourifauve -1 PO à tous ;: Naissance: Touslecat -1 range to all; Voracle invisible and healed; Killtamer skips your turn; Ripper pulls 1 cell.
text.Chasse : Ébourifauve pose un glyphe (50: Chasse: Touslecat places a glyph (50% current HP); Voracle +10% crit to monsters; Killtamer swaps places; Ripper +200 Power.
text.Repos : Ébourifauve renvoie le prochain: Repos: Touslecat reflects the next spell; Voracle pushes back 3; Killtamer teleports symmetrically; Ripper dispels everyone.
text.Bonus de saison pour tout le combat : Na: Season bonus for the whole fight: Naissance +1 MP, Chasse +20% final damage, Repos +20% vitality.
text.Achever un monstre à 4 attaques subies é: Finishing a monster at 4 attacks taken avoids its effect.
text.Les glyphes du Disciple du Kimbo retiren: Kimbo's Disciple's glyphs remove 400% resistance in two elements from the Kimbo for 1 turn.
text.Frapper le Kimbo Terre ou Eau : le Disci: Hit the Kimbo with Earth or Water: the Disciple places his glyphs at an odd distance from himself.
text.Frapper le Kimbo Air ou Feu : glyphes à: Hit the Kimbo with Air or Fire: glyphs at an even distance.
text.Commencer son tour sur un de ces glyphes: Starting your turn on one of these glyphs kills: stand at the other parity before the Disciple's turn, out of his melee.
text.Le Kimbo qui commence son tour sur un gl: A Kimbo starting his turn on a glyph loses 400% resistance in those two elements (and gains some in the other two) for 1 turn.
text.Le Disciple bouge ensuite d'1 case : les: The Disciple then moves 1 cell: the next glyphs land elsewhere.
text.Chaque case porte un chiffre de 1 à 6 ;: Each cell has a number from 1 to 6; everyone takes the Die state of the cell where they end their turn.
text.En fin de tour, le Chaloeil invoque des: At end of turn, the Catseye summons Dice (2,000 HP) on cells of his number at an even distance, and white glyphs at an odd distance.
text.Finir son tour sur un glyphe blanc soign: Ending your turn on a white glyph fully heals.
text.Gros Yeux (tours 3, 6, 9…) : lui et ses: Big Eyes (turns 3, 6, 9…): he and his allies get a bonus by their Die, 1 turn.
text.Dé 1 : 200 Esquive PM ; Dé 2 : +5 PO ; D: Die 1: 200 MP Dodge; Die 2: +5 range; Die 3: Unmovable.
text.Dé 4 : +3 PM ; Dé 5 : soin de 20 % des P: Die 4: +3 MP; Die 5: 20% HP heal; Die 6: +600 Power.
text.Routourne : chaque monstre du Grand Jeu: The Wheeturn: each Grand Jeu monster gets a different bonus each turn, in a 3-turn cycle; only the current bonus can be dispelled.
text.Hell Mina est Lourde et invulnérable jus: Hell Mina is Heavy and invulnerable until 6 attacks in the elements she sets.
text.À chacun de ses tours, chaque personnage: Each of her turns, each character gets an element (Earth, Water, Fire or Air Rage state).
text.Un sort de cet élément, même lancé dans: A spell of that element, even cast on an empty cell, adds 1 to her Rage: once per character and element received.
text.Sans attaque de l'élément reçu : 500 dég: No attack of the element received: 500 damage in that element, and nothing is added.
text.À 5, plus aucun état n'est affiché : une: At 5, no state is shown any more: one last attack of the element is enough.
text.À 6, elle devient vulnérable, avec +3 PM: At 6, she becomes vulnerable, with +3 MP, +40% final damage and +50% crit: kill the monsters first.
text.Un monstre proche de toi pose une rune ;: A monster near you places a rune; on its next turn, a Demonic Arm appears there with a radius-2 glyph.
text.La rune te retire 100 Puissance 1 tour,: The rune removes 100 Power from you for 1 turn, or gives +200 Power to a nearby monster. One rune every 3 turns.
text.Entrer dans le glyphe d'un Bras déclench: Entering an Arm's glyph triggers one of its spells (600 Neutral): pushes back 2, teleports symmetrically, or hits in a radius 2.
text.Un personnage sur la rune quand le monst: A character on the rune when the monster starts its turn: 300 Fire, no Arm, and they control every Arm that turn (without their glyphs).
text.Instabilité Chaotique : chaque ligne de: Chaotic Instability: each damage line removes 5% resistance in the element hit and grants it randomly elsewhere (element, pushback or crit).
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé E: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Water. +2 MP when the Kralove is vulnerable.
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé F: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Fire. +2 MP when the Kralove is vulnerable.
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé T: Summoned when the Kralove is hit Earth. +2 MP when the Kralove is vulnerable.
