In Fearless state, only the Fearless target hits her without turning Pacifist. Outside Fearless, she swaps with her weapons.
text.Chaque Nimpatience réduit ses dégâts sub: Each Stubbygerness level reduces his damage taken.
text.Chaque Éclat tué augmente ses dommages :: Each Chip killed raises her damage: kill 3 once the monsters are dead. She summons one every 2 turns, which makes her invulnerable again: after 3 Chips killed (counter III), killing the new one is enough to make her vulnerable.
text.Début de tour : échange de place avec un: Turn start: swaps places with a character in contact; a character in Gravity or Rooted takes Fire damage instead. Vinriktus swaps his target with the ally nearest to it. Under Sit, move as little as possible.
text.En début de tour, vole les stats des mon: At turn start, steals stats from monsters in Collection state she can see; she loses them when they die. Carrions give her shield. Dakhma (range 2) removes your AP and MP: hitting the affected ally cancels it. Below 50% HP, finish her fast.
text.En fin de tour, gagne bouclier et tacle: At end of turn, gains shield and Lock per enemy within 4 range. A summon in his reach keeps him busy for a turn or two.
text.Hitomi réduit ses dégâts subis et en ren: Hitomi reduces the damage he takes and reflects part of it. After Nozomi, he and his target swap places whenever either is hit: the Lantern on them removes the state.
text.Indéplaçable sans ennemi à 4 PO: Unmovable with no enemy within 4 range
text.Inoffensif à distance : jouer à distance: Harmless at range: play at range or lock him.
text.Invocations à placer hors de sa vue et d: Place summons out of his sight and spread out. Only Razof can kill the Minikron, in melee: the team then loses 2 AP and 20% res. Don't let it end on his black glyph (-MP, Erosion). Locking him blocks Shovellista.
text.Invulnérable 1 tour en montant sur sa mo: Invulnerable for 1 turn when mounting, then finish her before she plays again. Dakhma (range 2) removes your AP and MP: hitting the affected ally cancels it. Trapped with summons in contact, she kills them into Carrions that block her.
text.La Lanterne des Spiritueurs (sort spécia: The Lantern (the dungeon's special spell) affects monsters: it reveals the Kaonashi, removes the Madura's state and kills the Bakazako's copies in its glyph.
text.Lancer Nécronyx sur chaque monstre avant: Cast Necronyx on each monster before killing it: once revived, it won't play anymore. From turn 2, end within range 6 of a monster, or they all gain 2 MP and 1 range.
text.Le frapper une fois par tour l'empêche d: Hitting him once per turn stops his AP and MP removal next turn, but he gains 10 MP and hits hard in melee. He casts his removal only 3 times per turn: summons can soak it up.
text.Le taper à 2 PO ou moins attire au CaC e: Hitting him from range 2 or less pulls you into melee and triggers Certain Death on each hit. His Harrowing Cry (range 7 around him) makes you Deafened: Certain Death then applies Unhealable and Gravity. Gains Vitality and damage on each monster death.
text.Les Bras tapent Neutre : chaque coup Neu: The Arms hit Neutral: each Neutral hit removes 5% Neutral resistance from him. Put him in an Arm's range. Killing an Arm prevents the 5th.
text.Ne pas rester dans le glyphe d'un Bras d: Don't stay in a Demonic Arm's glyph on its turn.
text.Ne tape qu'au CaC, puis recule. Soigne s: Only hits in melee, then backs off. Heals allies up to range 6, not himself. A character or a summon next to him serves as bait: he hits, then backs off; the others stay out of reach. No high-Lock bait.
text.PA si sa cible est déplacée: AP if its target is moved
text.Pacifiste si ses 2 états cumulés: Pacifist if both its states stack
text.Plus de 100 % de rés. : le garder loin,: Over 100% res.: keep him away, wait for his Stubbygerness 3. For the next 2 turns, each push or pull removes 5% res. (kept); pushback damage gives him 10% back. A summon 2 cells away reduces his leap to 1 cell.
text.Réduit les dommages de sa cible sur les: Reduces its target's damage on Olgoths.
text.Sa vague tuée, il tombe 2 tours : le tap: Once his wave is dead, he is down for 2 turns: hit him down to his threshold, or he hits the whole team as he gets up. Paw strikes show a red glyph first: don't end in it (one-shot). Stay on the sides: Beastly Barrage pulls you to the middle.
text.Son Malterego donne 3 PA contre un poiso: His Malterego gives 3 AP for one poison per AP used: use few or kill the Malterego before the turn ends. Gravity or Rooted stops his place swap.
text.Sous 50 % PV en début de tour, il devien: Below 50% HP at the start of his turn, he turns invisible, then heals and gains a shield: leave him at 55-60% HP and kill him the next turn, or make him Unhealable. Walking on a blue glyph reveals the Kitsounebi.
text.Sous 75 % et 50 % PV, passe dans ton cam: Below 75% and 50% HP, joins your side for 2 turns (invulnerable, her glyph boosts your damage and kills monsters); the 2nd time, surviving wins the fight. On turns 3, 6, 9, stay behind an obstacle. Don't erode or heal her.
text.Taclé et dos à un mur, il ne peut plus r: Locked with his back to a wall, he can no longer back off or hit (he hits from range 3 or more).
text.Tant que des monstres vivent, finir son: While monsters are alive, end your turn in sight of an enemy, or a Cauchemar appears near you for a turn.
text.Tape toute l'équipe tous les 2 tours (po: Hits the whole team every 2 turns (poison per MP used) and those in contact with him at every turn start. Each dead monster heals him but removes some of his resistances. While he lives, ending in your brown turn-start glyph heals you.
text.Taper l'allié changé en Théière annule l: Hitting the ally turned into a Teapot cancels the effect.
text.Taper un Éclat Kao donne Chocolathée 3 t: Hitting a Chokao Chip gives Chocolathiest for 3 turns (monsters hit you harder): finishing it in one hit, with poison or a bomb avoids it.
text.Tous les monstres invoquent des Bombombr: All monsters summon Cucumbombs, whose glyph hits.
text.Traître : finir son tour sur un glyphe b: Traitorous: end your turn on a white glyph; then hitting one of your allies adds 1 charge (5 max), each hit on Servitude uses one. Unhealable before 1 HP prevents her heal.

Traitorous: end your turn on a white glyph; then hitting one of your allies adds 1 charge (5 max), each hit on Servitude uses one. At 1 HP, sends everyone back to start and heals 25%, unless Unhealable.
text.Tuer le Monolithe (invulnérable à distan: Killing the Monolith (invulnerable at range) brings the Dagon to your side: only it can hit Bethel, in melee. Before that, push the Dagon each turn so it can't pull itself in. Necronyx on Bethel from turn 1, then every 3 turns.
text.Vulnérable seulement à 2 PO : y entrer p: Only vulnerable at range 2: step in to hit him, step out before his turn. One-shots the team on turn 25. No moving him, no MP removal: a tank in his sight, away from the team, keeps him busy. Below 80% HP, each hidden character heals him: hide anyway.
text.attire au CaC d'un Bras en ligne: pulls you to an Arm in line
text.monstres en vue d'un monstre tué: monsters in sight of a killed monster
text.passe ton tour si Météoroïde: you skip your turn if Meteoroid
text.passe ton tour si Tyrannisé: you skip your turn if Tyrannised
text.pousse, te ramène au départ: pushes, sends you back to your start cell
text.sauf au centre du glyphe blanc: except in the centre of the white glyph
text.te change en Goule à 3 PO: turns you into a Ghoul at range 3
text.À 3 PO, elle change un personnage en Gou: At range 3, she turns a character into a Ghoul (+50% damage taken); a hit from an ally or from himself ends it. Each Ghoul raises the damage she takes: normal at 3 Ghouls. Otherwise, keep her away and erode her.
text.À 6 de Rage, vulnérable et bien plus for: At Rage 6, vulnerable and much stronger: not before the monsters die.
text.À chaque seuil : invulnérable 5 tours et: At each threshold: invulnerable for 5 turns and back to 100% HP; Queen Amirukam helps you during those 5 turns. His glyph kills ink monsters still inside when he wakes. Gravity blocks his leap.

At each threshold: invulnerable for 5 turns and back to 100% HP; King Imagami helps you during those 5 turns. Her glyph kills paper monsters still inside when she wakes. Stay off her lines and diagonals.
text.échange avec qui lui retire PM: swaps with whoever removes its MP
text.équipe, s'il meurt sans Nécronyx: team, if it dies without Necronyx
text.Cri de Reconstitution (relance 7 tours): Cry of Recovery (7-turn cooldown) heals a lot, herself or an ally, then makes her Unhealable for 3 turns: wound her a little, isolate her, and start on her once the spell is cast.
text.Un monstre qui voit un personnage à plus: A monster that sees a character beyond 4 range at the start of its turn teleports onto them and boosts itself: stay out of its sight, or within 4 range.
text.Chaque ligne de dégâts qu'un monstre inf: Each line of damage a monster deals to a character gives that monster a Stubbygerness (damage, then new spells at level III): keep them at a distance, MP removal helps.
text.Chaque coup d'un monstre baisse la résis: Each monster hit lowers its target's resistance, and its own, in its element (3 turns, stacks). Preferably hit a monster outside the Loutbear's damage share.
text.Sa Rage Reconstituante ne marche que sou: His Restorative Rage only works below 80% HP: leave him around 82% so he wastes it, erode him, reduce his heals. Each character's 1st hit is halved; +30 Power per hit taken. What he kills in melee becomes a Boowolf.
text.Mulanthropie (au CaC, tous les 2 tours): Boolanthropy (melee, every 2 turns): if its target dies, a Boowolf appears.
text.Les monstres dorment 2 tours puis jouent: Monsters sleep for 2 turns then play for 2 turns, alternating; hitting them wakes them for 2 turns. Hitting or killing a monster also alerts the monsters within 3 range of it.
text.Vulnérable quand l'Autel rejoue sur elle: Vulnerable when the Altar replays on her the reaction (5 hits) of the Voracle in Naissance, the Killtamer in Chasse, the Touslecat in Repos. +1 permanent MP per monster in line with her. Dispel Brutank's sharing. Unerodable.
text.Après 5 attaques subies, chaque monstre: After taking 5 attacks, each monster triggers an effect based on the season. Waves on turns 1, 6, 11…
text.Les Tamponneurs (150 % rés.) renvoient d: The Stamper Wobots (150% res.) send anything pushed onto them back 6 cells: pushed between two of them 5 cells apart in line, it bounces until it dies. Don't end your turn next to them. +30% res. on turn 3, then every 5 turns.
text.Taper une illusion la fait disparaître,: Hitting an illusion makes it vanish; hitting the real one makes them all vanish. To find him: an area spell, or an end-of-turn poison put on him from turn 1 (he reveals himself when it hits).
text.Si elle commence son tour dans le glyphe: If it starts its turn in the glyph of a Jelly of another colour, it loses resistances in that glyph's element.
text.Le désenvoûter quand il se booste : Spor: Dispel him when he boosts: Fungal Ove fully heals him if hit, or if he loses AP or MP (one of the three, shown in preview). Sirop Spore: poison per AP used.
text.Ne pas taper la Poupée : ses dégâts subi: Don't hit the Doll: the damage it takes goes to the Cursed character, and he resummons it as soon as it dies. It hits within 2 cells at end of turn, harder and harder. It swaps places and removes range (turn 1, then every 4 turns).
text.Après ses glyphes, il bouge d'1 case : l: After his glyphs, he moves 1 cell: the cells without a glyph get one next turn. Push him an odd number of cells, or end your turn on a glyphed cell (if you keep the same pair of elements).
text.Ne tape pas, mais son Souffle (dès le to: Doesn't hit, but his Breath (from turn 2, in line within 5 range, with line of sight) turns a character into a Gobkool with no AP for 1 turn: avoid his lines, hide, dispel. A summoned Gobkool makes its allies invisible with 5 MP.
text.Invoqué quand le Kralamoure est frappé A: Summoned when the Kralove is hit with Air.
text.Le finir en un tour avant son soin (vers: Finish him in one turn before his heal (around 20% HP). In Parted state, killing his legs (Father Kwismas) wins the fight; Half Father Kwismas removes MP, turns you into a gift (-4 AP, Weakened) and pushes. Removing MP from Father Kwismas gives him range.
text.Le finir en un tour dès 35 % PV, avant s: Finish him in one turn from 35% HP, before his heal (around 30%). A Poutch boosted twice in AP kills the whole team: kill it before the recast (3 turns).
text.L'amener à 14 PA (lui retirer des PA lui: Get him to 14 AP (removing AP makes him gain some, giving him AP works too): he casts Hololol, 2 turns where each hit removes resistance in the hit's element and gives him some in the others. Always hit with the same element.
text.Jusqu'à 2 par tour. 75 % de résistances,: Up to 2 per turn. 75% resistances, except -75% in a random element. Keep it away from the Bherb: it would restore all his HP.
text.Kackitu (au CaC, tous les 7 tours) tue s: KilleRat (melee, every 7 turns) kills its target if it takes Earth or Neutral damage that turn: leave him a summon in melee. Don't heal under Black Plague (life steal doesn't count). Don't hit with Earth/Neutral under Korrattion.
text.Rascasse (2 tours) : chaque coup lui don: Sprat (2 turns): each hit gives him 50% resistance in the element used. Dispelling him resets his resistances to zero. A character under White Plague loses all their buffs if healed.
text.Le mettre en Pesanteur et à 0 PM pour qu: Put him in Gravity and at 0 MP so he doesn't leap away from the turtles stuck to him.
text.Sous Rascasse (2 tours), chaque coup lui: Under Sprat (2 turns), each hit gives him 50% resistance in the element received: dispel him. Healing a target under White Plague dispels it.
text.sauf tortue collée (-200 %): except with a turtle stuck to it (-200%)
text.Le Scarafeuille Noir rend lui et ses all: The Black Scaraleaf makes itself and its nearby allies invisible from its 2nd turn. Stay at range: the monsters mostly hit at short range. The Immatures transform after 2 turns.
text.Dès son 2e tour, le Tofukaz rend invisib: From its 2nd turn, the Tofukaz makes itself and nearby allies invisible. Back off to lure the fleeing Tofus.
text.Rend toute l'équipe Insoignable 1 tour (: Makes the whole team Unhealable for 1 turn (every 3 turns): don't count on heals. Hits up to 4 range in all 4 elements, stealing life and MP.
text.Éviter d'invoquer : la Malédiction du Mo: Avoid summoning: the Curse of the Mumminotor then kills all summons and removes MP from the whole team (6-turn cooldown).
text.Malédiction (s'il existe une invocation: Curse (if an enemy summon exists, every 6 turns): kills all summons and removes MP from the whole team. Its Jellidices give a random boost to all the monsters.
text.soigner un perso collé à lui: heal a character next to it
text.Soigner un personnage collé à lui le ren: Healing a character next to him makes him vulnerable for 6 turns; he turns invulnerable again if the healed character dies. Pushing or pulling him lets you heal from the damage you deal him for 1 turn.
text.La Pougnette explose à son 5e tour et tu: The Maglob explodes on its 5th turn, killing enemies beyond 7 range: stand 1-7 range from it or kill it (it reflects damage). Pushing a character into him makes him vulnerable for 3 turns; pushing a monster into him heals him.
text.Le Hamrack (2 PM, indéplaçable) doit exp: The Hamrack (2 MP, unmovable) must explode in his melee (vulnerable for 5 turns): push Buck towards it and block Buck. Trying to remove the Hamrack's MP gives it 3: it reaches Buck faster. The explosion hurts the characters around.
text.sauf Hamrack explosé à son CaC: except when a Hamrack explodes in its melee
text.Ne peut pas être portée. Ses glyphes ent: Cannot be carried. Its glyphs surround the team from the start of the fight, and it pushes or swaps places to send you onto them.
text.Un tour sur deux (Kirbili) : frapper un: Every other turn (Kirbili): hitting a monster gives it damage but heals the characters near that monster. His death strengthens the Kolosso.
text.Sous leur état, frapper le Glouragan att: Under their state, hitting the Glouragan pulls whatever is in line with it; hitting the Glourmand gives it pushback damage.
text.si déplacé ou -PM/PO, PV pleins: if moved or MP/range removed, full HP
text.Sous Glours poursuite, le frapper attire: Under Glours poursuite, hitting it pulls everything in line with it: don't hit it while it is aligned with the Glourseleste, who, once pulled, revives his allies. Its area also hits its allies.
text.le dernier mort, en Zombi: the last one killed, as a Zombie
text.tuer un Zombi Instant à son CaC: kill an Instant Zombie in its melee
text.Pus des Pieds : poison qui blesse selon: Pus des Pieds: a poison that hurts for each MP used.
text.Les monstres tués reviennent en Zombi ;: Killed monsters come back as Zombies; when finished off, a Zombie explodes (5 range) and makes Pacifist anyone at 90% HP or more. Finishing the first one kills the whole chain. Mortier: its target takes Water damage on each melee hit it receives.
text.Ne peut devenir vulnérable qu'à partir d: Can only become vulnerable from turn 3. Once vulnerable, he casts Cuir à feu doux: he and his allies return to their start-of-turn cell with Lock and Damage; a character on that cell swaps places and loses 6 MP.
text.Gonflage : poison qui tape selon les PM: Gonflage: a poison that hits for each MP used, if you are within 5 range of it.
text.se prépare 1 tour puis tape fort: charges up for 1 turn, then hits hard
text.Frappée, elle attire à son contact les p: When hit, she pulls the characters in line or diagonal with her into contact and makes them Frozen.
text.Pesanteur autour, tapé de loin: Gravity around it, when hit at range
text.à 5 PO, s'il est tapé de loin: within 5 range, if hit at range
text.Tuée avant ses 4 tours : frappe Feu et r: Killed before its 4 turns: hits Fire and makes Unhealable within 8 range.
text.Tuée avant ses 4 tours : frappe Terre et: Killed before its 4 turns: hits Earth and reduces your damage by 20% within 8 range.
text.Tuée avant ses 4 tours : frappe Air et r: Killed before its 4 turns: hits Air and removes 4 MP within 8 range.
text.Tuée avant ses 4 tours : frappe Eau et a: Killed before its 4 turns: hits Water and increases your damage taken by 20% within 8 range.
text.Ne jamais finir au contact d'un allié :: Never end your turn in contact with an ally: they die. Hit him in melee on turns 3, 6, 9… From turn 3, on odd turns, Pacifist on characters far from him, closer and closer. The pink glyph of the swap removes Dodge and Lock.
text.Le frapper : tour impair, tu passes de l: Hitting him: on odd turns, you move to his other side; on even turns, he moves. Impossible landing cell: the team dies. Cast in line or diagonal to handle the confusion. Vulnerable: Gravity against his teleports.
text.Rester sous 90 % PV avant de tuer un mon: Stay below 90% HP before killing a resummoned monster. Put the zombie 5 to 10 cells from him and move away from its explosion before finishing it.
text.Marcher sur une congère repousse les ent: Walking onto a snowdrift pushes the entities in line or diagonal around you; a pushed enemy is vulnerable for 1 turn. Watch out for pushback damage on the team.
text.sauf Silhouette au glyphe blanc: unless the Silhouette is in the white glyph
text.Vulnérable si la Silhouette est dans le: Vulnerable when the Silhouette is in the Globilum's white glyph and he is outside it. Only one move per turn on him and on the Silhouette, which flees after hitting. The Globilum, invulnerable, moves one cell per turn.
text.Après Griffes enflammées, être poussé ou: After Griffes enflammées, being pushed or taking pushback damage makes you skip your turn.
text.Reflets placides : le personnage marqué: Reflets placides: the marked character (green) must be the first to hit the Levitrof before their own next turn, or that character dies on the Levitrof's turn. Killing the Levitrof cancels the effect.
text.La Boubourse booste les monstres. À 1 PV: The Boubourse boosts the monsters. At 1 HP, it joins your side for 2 turns, then returns next to King Nidas.
text.Intérêts : lui et celui qui le tape gagn: Intérêts: he and whoever hits him gain Power with each hit. Below 50% HP, he gains shield per damage line received: hit him with big single-line hits.
text.La Bombe Illicale explose à son tour sui: The Illicit Bomb explodes on its next turn or when it dies; it moves 3 cells closer to whoever hits a monster. Remove MP from the Terristocrat.
text.Monstres (Krobes) invulnérables : les ta: The monsters (Krobes) are invulnerable: hitting them hurts the Malamibe, which kills the team if it lives 2 full turns. Each Krobe dies when its condition is held 3 turns in a row.
text.meurt si condition tenue 3 tours: dies if its condition is held 3 turns
text.meurt si ni déplacée ni -PM: dies if neither moved nor MP-removed
text.meurt si personne à 5 PO: dies if nobody is within 5 range
text.meurt si un perso à son contact: dies if a character is in contact
text.Au-dessus de 50 % PV : garder Fraktale à: Above 50% HP: keep Fraktale more than 4 cells from the Auroraire, or your damage spells heal instead of hurting. Below 50% HP, the opposite: keep her within 4 cells.
text.Son Auroraire règle les dégâts de tous :: His Auroraire sets everyone's damage: low until the 5th hour, high from the 6th to the 11th; kill XLII before the 12th hour (it drops again). When moved, he swaps places with an ally: put him in Gravity. His death removes the Auroraire.
text.Vulnérable, le jouer à distance, hors de: Once vulnerable, play at range, out of his lines. Revives every monster killed; a monster killed twice at the same hour of the Auroraire stays dead (yellow star). Every 3 turns, he teleports next to the Auroraire: stay away from it.
text.La taper à distance. Sorts surtout en li: Hit her at range. Her spells are mostly in line: stay out of her lines and remove her MP.
text.La taper quand des Trégénaires vivent le: Hitting her while Tregenaires are alive makes them Devoted: they come and explode in an area next to a character. Hitting an Egg heals you for half the damage dealt.
text.À son début de tour, le plus proche et c: At the start of his turn, the nearest character and those he made Cursed (melee hit) roll minimum damage and take Water damage; at 30% HP or less, they die. Gravity blocks his swap; alone, he is no longer dangerous.
text.au CaC, cible à 50 % PV max: in melee, target at 50% HP or less
text.100 % de résistances partout. Le Moon pe: 100% resistance everywhere. Moon loses his resistance in an element when the totem of that element, summoned by Darkli Moon, is placed on the glyph of its colour.
text.Un coup ne le touche qu'en alternant : e: A hit only lands if you alternate: in the Red state hit him in melee, in the Black state at range. Each hit received changes his state. Hard to leave his melee (strong Lock).
text.à 5 PO, 1er coup de chacun: within 5 range, each one's first hit
text.si même Dé qu'un monstre: if same Die as a monster
text.ses alliés si on tape sa cible: its allies if its target is hit
text.Les monstres sont invulnérables : ils pe: The monsters are invulnerable: they lose 25% HP per turn (dead in 4 turns) and are more dangerous at low HP. Slow them down (MP removal, pushes). Healing the targets of Eclair Obscur (Mantaze) removes Conductor.
text.Surveiller la Folie (mort à Folie 10) :: Watch your Madness (death at Madness 10): the Klutist, the Grofond and the Li-Fo add some when they hit. Hitting an ally removes one Madness from them.
text.Chaque coup direct t'échange avec l'enti: Each direct hit swaps you with the nearest entity; twice the same one in a turn: one Madness. Prefer poisons and single-line spells. In Gravity, he doesn't swap with his allies and you aren't teleported next to him.
text.si Affaibli, en ligne à 2 PO: if Weakened, in line within 2 range
text.placer 4 Totems sur leur glyphe: put the 4 Totems on their glyphs
text.En fin de tour, on échange avec le Totem: At end of turn, you swap with the nearest Totem, which leaves a black glyph. Kill the 4 Totems (500 HP): no more swaps until they return on turn 6 (then every 5 turns). Hitting a Totem in line with its element pulls it.
text.Dès le tour 3, Carapace d'Ailes 2 tours: From turn 3, Carapace of Wings for 2 turns: he stops playing, reflects damage and steals HP from everyone. On his turn, he triggers all runes, not only his own. His death removes his allies' 50% resistances.
text.tes Boufcools si on le retape: your Boufcools if it is hit again
text.En ligne (tour pair) ou en diagonale (to: In line (even turn) or diagonal (odd turn) with the Koolich when he is hit, it goes into Kewlitude: +3 AP, +3 MP, +100% final damage and heals each turn. Not dangerous without this bonus.
text.Tapé en ligne : il fonce, frappe autour: Hit in line: he charges, hits around himself, -10% res., +10% final damage. Only 10 hits count per turn, even out of line: a tank hits in line right after his turn. Toromatic stacks: keep him away from his allies.
text.Il subit les dégâts infligés aux Pichons: He takes the damage dealt to the Snappers and loses 1% resistance per line; his death wins the fight. Scrub (3+ range, line of sight) makes you Scrubbed: he then hits very hard at 2 range. Lock him or hide. 0 pushback res.
text.fin de tour dans le glyphe rouge: turn end in the red glyph
text.Son glyphe rouge apparaît autour de chaq: His red glyph appears around each character: leave it before turn end. Gravity prevents teleporting, an MP gain or an Abyssal Dofus helps.
text.Tué, il revient dans ton camp sous le co: Killed, he comes back on your side under his killer's control. His Antiks doubles the damage reflected onto the Sponge Mob. Protect him: killed by a monster, he goes back to the enemy.
text.Les Branches restent invulnérables tant: Branches stay invulnerable while the Soft Oak lives.
text.Sa cible soigne le monstre le plus proch: Its target heals the nearest monster on each move, not each MP: move in one go, next to a monster that has lost no HP.
text.Durakuir : les monstres se renforcent en: Tuffguy: monsters grow stronger as they lose HP. Hit one monster at a time, no area spells, and keep the others away (MP removal). Killing a monster boosts its killer for 2 turns (“Fren?”): chain on.
text.le perso qui tue un monstre: the character who kills a monster
text.Ne pas le tuer tant que le Scarabosse Do: Don't kill it while the Golden Scarabugly lives: its death gives him a big damage bonus.
text.S'il prend la couleur d'un Scarafeuille: If it takes the colour of an already-killed Scaraleaf, the Golden Scarabugly regains that resistance. Hystairia makes the Golden Scarabugly Unlockable with 4 MP for 1 turn: dispel him if he is locked.
text.Toute entité devient Tas d'Os à 1 % PV :: Every entity becomes a Pile of Bones at 1% HP: a monster revives after 2 turns, a character dies on its turn. On a black glyph (hitting them pulls them), an ally revives and an enemy stays frozen. All frozen: victory.
text.noirs : y placer les Tas d'Os: black: put the Piles of Bones on them
text.sauf s'il débute sur glyphe noir: unless it starts on a black glyph
text.Taper le vrai Chafer Rōnin fait disparaî: Hitting the real Ronin Chafer makes his illusions vanish.
text.Il annule et renvoie les dégâts tant que: He cancels and reflects damage until his allies have hit him 3 times. The Chak Rat hits around itself at the start of its turn: keep it next to the White Rat 3 turns in a row, and don't kill every monster before that.
text.Il tape en croix autour de lui au début: It hits in a cross around itself at the start of its turn, allies included: next to the White Rat 3 turns in a row, it removes his reflect. Don't kill it before that.
text.16 PA au départ, +1 PA par tour pendant: 16 AP at the start, +1 AP per turn for 5 turns: dispel him every turn. At 20 AP, he casts Dazing Stone every turn (heavy damage, -6 AP and Crackrockification to all). Hitting him with Neutral gives his allies a big shield.
text.Peu de PV, pas d'invulnérabilité. Kackit: Low HP, no invulnerability. KilleRat applies Memento Mori: next turn, he teleports onto that character, hits it and makes it Unhealable: protect it. Healing a character removes the Air poison (Black Plague).
text.Il change ce qu'il tue en Mulou. Tous le: He turns what he kills into Boowolves. Every 3 turns, he kills his Boowolves to heal; without Boowolves, he loses resistances: kill them every turn. Cornered by 2 summons, he turns them into Boowolves that block him: kill them, put 2 back.
text.Chaque coup que tu portes au CaC retire: Each melee hit you land removes 1 MP from the monster hit for the whole fight (5 per turn at most). Monsters boost every 2 turns, in a cycle: +50% damage (turn 2), shield, Unlockable, heal.
text.L'entourer hors de son glyphe (qui le so: Surround him outside his glyph (it heals him and reduces ranged damage): if he uses no MP, he becomes vulnerable for 2 turns.
text.Entrer dans le glyphe d'un Bras déclench: Entering an Arm's glyph triggers one of its spells (heavy Neutral damage): pushes back 2, teleports symmetrically, or hits in a radius 2.
text.Un personnage sur la rune quand le monst: A character on the rune when the monster starts its turn takes Fire damage, prevents the Arm and controls every Arm that turn (without their glyphs).
text.Placer le Primaire devant le Kralamoure: Put the First in front of the Kralove to block his sight; the First must kill a summon hidden behind it, 2 turns in a row.
text.Après 5 attaques subies, chaque monstre: After taking 5 attacks, each monster triggers an effect based on the season. Against the Ripper, the Hunting Altar replays it, weakened, at end of turn.
text.En fin de tour, le Chalœil invoque des D: At end of turn, the Catseye summons Dice (2,000 HP) on cells of his number at an even distance, and white glyphs at an odd distance.
text.Dès le tour 2, chaque monstre (sauf le C: From turn 2, each monster (except the Catseye) erodes and hits the characters on the same Die as itself: end on another number.
text.Frapper le Kimbo Terre ou Eau : glyphes: Hit the Kimbo with Earth or Water: glyphs at an odd distance from the Disciple.
text.Brutale : +10 % de dommages finaux (20 %: Brutal: +10% final damage (20% to the Crocabulia). Killed before its 4 turns: hits Earth, -20% final damage.
text.Sans attaque de l'élément reçu : des dég: Without an attack of the element received: damage in that element, and nothing is added.
text.Magnétisme : Grasmera s'attire de 4 case: Magnetism: Grasmera pulls itself 4 cells onto you; a Tyrannised target skips its next turn.
text.La frapper à distance déclenche une télé: Hitting her at range triggers a teleport to the start-of-fight cell.
text.Les monstres de la saison arrivent par v: Season monsters come in waves of 3, 4, then 5: keep them at a distance. In phase 4, a season boss and 5 monsters.
Remove range from the Kanniball Sarbak.
text.Le Kanniboul Ebil la donne à tous les mo: The Kanniball Andchain gives it to every monster: when one takes damage, the monsters within 2 cells of it are healed for half of it.
text.Séparer les monstres : qu'aucun ne soit: Separate the monsters: none should be within 2 cells of the one you hit.
text.Ne jamais taper un Kanniboul à 2 cases o: Never hit a Kanniball within 2 cells of the Kanniball Andchain: he would be healed for half the damage.
text.Taper un seul monstre à la fois, à l'éca: Hitting one monster at a time, away from the others, limits these heals.
text.Sous leur état, frapper au CaC le Bléric: Under their state, hitting the Blerice in melee removes 100 MP from the team, and the Fleuro steals HP.
text.Aucun soin possible de tout le combat, s: No healing at all for the whole fight, except through Professor Xa's Kirbili. Razepoutine only fires if someone is in melee, in a cone, stronger at low HP. On Xa's death: +1 MP, Power and a ranged spell that removes Dodge.
text.À partir du tour 3, chaque personnage qu: From turn 3, each character who didn't end their previous turn in a white glyph becomes Pacifist for 1 turn.
text.Les 2 premiers tours, Peau lisse protège: For the first 2 turns, Peau lisse protects the characters: end in a white glyph from turn 2.
text.Klime et chaque monstre posent en début: Klime and each monster lay a one-cell white glyph at turn start, lasting 2 turns; a killed monster takes its glyphs with it.
text.Finir son tour dans un glyphe donne Peau: Ending your turn in a glyph gives Peau lisse. Klime or a monster ending there gains damage for 2 turns: dispel it.
text.Pas assez de glyphes : un personnage qui: Not enough glyphs: a character playing later can move out an ally who already played and take their spot.
text.Un personnage qui ne frappe pas peut res: A character who doesn't attack can stay Pacifist.
text.Tous les monstres tués avant le tour 3 :: All monsters killed before turn 3: Pacifist only from turn 4, but end in a glyph on turn 3.
text.Missiz Frizz et ses monstres sont Lourds: Missiz Freezz and her monsters are Heavy and invulnerable: an enemy pushed (snowdrift or spell) becomes vulnerable for 1 turn, but is healed.
text.À chaque début de tour d'un personnage,: At the start of each character's turn, a snowdrift (black glyph) appears on the 4 cells around them; summons don't make any.
text.Y marcher te soigne, te repousse d'une c: Stepping in heals you, pushes you back 1 cell, then pushes back 1 cell the entities in a cross (6 cells) and diagonal (3 cells) around you.
text.Monogel (tout le monde) : une entité pou: Monogel (everyone): an entity pushed by a spell is healed and pushes back 1 cell the entities in line and diagonal within 6 range.
text.Pas de monstre à ton contact en début de: No monster in contact at the start of your turn: moving through the snowdrift would push it and heal it.
text.Un personnage qui subit des dommages de: A character taking pushback damage gets erosion for the whole fight, plus heavy Neutral damage while Missiz Freezz lives.
text.Indéplaçable, Enraciné ou Inébranlable e: Unmovable, Rooted or Unshakable stop you being pushed by the snowdrifts; on Missiz Freezz, they stop her being healed.
text.Ne jamais finir dans le glyphe de l'Esko: Never end your turn in the Bartyclank's glyph.
text.Lui et ses monstres sont Indéplaçables t: He and his monsters are Unmovable all fight; trying to remove their MP hurts you (Fire, life steal). Under Bathyscaff, each hit taken strengthens Bronze Agent: don't hit him then, or stay out of his range.
text.Taper l'Orfélin à distance, le Kanihilan: Hit the Orfelin at range, the Kanihilan in melee (he reflects ranged spells).
text.La taper à distance. À sa mort, les mons: Hit her from range. On her death, the remaining monsters gain MP, Power and resistances for the whole fight. Monsters within 2 cells of a character gain Power and critical. Kills a targeted summon from turn 3.
text.Garder les monstres à distance. Éloigner: Keep the monsters at range. Keep the Bomb Ilical away from allies.
text.Mort en sursis se lève si une Bonbombe b: Impending Death is lifted if a blue Bonbomb heals the character or if the Queen dies. On her death, the team takes more damage.
text.Chaque personnage invoque à chaque tour: Each character summons a Bonbomb 2 cells in front of them every turn; a red one that explodes kills every character in line with it.
text.Dès qu'un personnage a 2 Bonbombes, la p: Once a character has 2 Bonbombs, the oldest explodes on their turn and sets off those in line with it, one after another.
text.Rouge : tue les personnages et invocatio: Red: kills characters and summons in line up to 10 cells away and hits the monsters in that area.
text.Une Bonbombe en diagonale d'une explosio: A Bonbomb diagonal to an explosion turns blue: it fully heals the characters in line and hits the monsters.
text.Une rouge dans ta ligne te tue même si u: A red one in your line kills you even if a blue one heals you.
text.Elles sont invulnérables : on peut les p: They are invulnerable: they can be pushed, not carried (Heavy). A blue icon with a white triangle shows one is about to explode.
text.Sans place à 2 PO devant toi, elle appar: With no room 2 cells in front of you, it appears on the next cell clockwise.
text.La Reine des Voleurs n'est pas blessée p: The Queen of Thieves isn't hurt by the bombs and takes 10% less damage per Bonbomb down: hit her when few are down.
text.Une vague tous les 5 tours. Les Soldats: A wave every 5 turns. The Soldiers of Fortune hit at range.
text.Le garder sur une case 6 dans un coin, l: Keep him on a 6 cell in a corner, away from the waves, while removing his MP. So he can't swap places with the monsters, keep them away from him, remove their MP or put them in Gravity.
text.Jouer à distance, beaucoup de sorts se l: Play at range, many spells are cast in melee. The Levitos remove AP and MP and are a nuisance all fight.
text.Guerillero (tout le combat) : un personn: Guerillero (all fight): a character ending their turn hurts the allies next to them.
text.Dans le combat du Père Ver, un monstre q: In the Wurmlord fight, a dying monster hits every character in its line of sight.
text.Avant d'achever un monstre, couper sa li: Before finishing off a monster, break its line of sight to your characters.
text.Chaque monstre mort retire des résistanc: Each dead monster removes resistances from the Wurmlord for the whole fight, but heals him.
text.Frapper un monstre donne Maudification à: Hitting a monster gives Cursification to its nearest neighbour (-50% ranged damage).
text.Frappe comme si elle était à la place de: Hits as if she stood in any ally's place: never stay in line with a monster. Revives each killed monster the next turn (-1 MP), on its glyph: eroding it brings it back with low HP.
text.4 états de 3 tours (Aurore, Zénith, Crép: 4 states lasting 3 turns (Aurora, Zenith, Twilight, Nadir); Necronyx: next state. Zenith: Gravity immobilises him; stay out of his pushback. Nadir: reapply Necronyx, kill him before his turn. The edge glyph hits whoever starts a turn on it.
text.Sa Lunorbe rend tout ennemi invulnérable: Her Moonorb makes every enemy invulnerable: a damage line from the blue glyph lifts it on the target for your turn. Killing her during New or Full Moon, or with a summon, avoids the one-shot; once she dies, everything turns vulnerable.
text.Peau pourrissante (-90 % de tes dégâts): Peau pourrissante (-90% of your damage) goes at the first heal received. Diseases: 3 heals or lifesteal.
text.Le Feu Primordial booste l'équipe : son: The Primordial Fire boosts the team: its summoner (1st in initiative) must not die.
text.Corruption le donne à lui et à tous ses: Corruption gives it to himself and all his allies: each damage line you deal one of them gives you a big Earth poison at end of turn.
text.Le poison se cumule : impossible de gagn: The poison stacks: the fight can't be won without removing Kissiphrot.
text.Soigner un allié, une invocation ou toi-: Healing an ally, a summon or yourself in melee with a monster removes that monster's Kissiphrot, and pushes it back 1 cell.
text.Retiré à Corruption, il descend de sa mo: Removed from Corruption, he dismounts for 3 turns; if still alive, he remounts and gives Kissiphrot back to himself and all his allies.
text.Frappé, le Koulosse change en Boufcool p: When hit, the Koolich turns the entities in line with him (even turn) or diagonal (odd turn) into Boufcools for 1 turn.
text.Un Bouftou des cavernes en Kewlitude gag: A Cave Gobball in Kewlitude gains AP, MP, damage and heals; without this bonus, they aren't dangerous.
text.Tant qu'ils vivent, ne pas taper le Koul: While they live, don't hit the Koolich when a Gobball is in line (even turn) or diagonal (odd turn) with him.
text.Un personnage ou une invocation en Boufc: A character or summon turned Boufcool loses its AP, becomes Pacifist, Unlockable and Unable to Lock, and is healed a little.
text.Un Boufcool qui commence son tour à 2 ca: A Boufcool starting its turn within 2 cells of an entity removes 20% of its resistances for 2 turns: that's how to weaken the Koolich.
text.Placer des invocations peu chères dans s: Place cheap summons in his line or diagonal (depending on the turn) within 2 cells of him, then hit him only once.
text.Le retaper alors qu'un Boufcool est enco: Hitting him again while a Boufcool is still lined up puts it in Maximum Kewlitude: a character or summon dies from it.
text.Un Bouftou en Kewlitude Maximale gagne u: A Gobball in Maximum Kewlitude gains a spell, and the Koolich summons more often.
text.Sortir du glyphe rouge du Pichon Orange: Leave the Brown Snapper's red glyph before turn end.
text.taper les Pichons, en zone: hit the Snappers, with area spells
text.Le Scarabosse Doré résiste fort partout: The Golden Scarabugly resists heavily everywhere except Neutral: each Scaraleaf killed removes 50% of his resistance in its element.
text.Blanc : Air ; Vert : Terre ; Bleu : Eau: White: Air; Green: Earth; Blue: Water; Red: Fire.
text.Chaque Scarafeuille mort le booste aussi: Each dead Scaraleaf also boosts him (MP, pushback damage, its element's characteristic): kill only 1 or 2.
text.Chacun laisse une Flammèche de son éléme: Each leaves a Spark of its element that hits hard around it: kill it before its turn.
text.Il invoque un Scarafeuille Immature au t: He summons an Immature Scaraleaf on turn 1, then every 5 turns; in 2 turns, it turns into a random Scaraleaf.
text.S'il prend la couleur d'un Scarafeuille: If it takes the colour of a dead Scaraleaf, the Golden Scarabugly regains that resistance.
text.Butin 6 et plus : le Scarafeuille Noir,: Loot 6 and up: the Black Scaraleaf, once dead, gives the Golden Scarabugly a lot of damage: don't kill it while he lives.
text.Placer les monstres dans les lignes des: Put the monsters in the Bonbombs' lines.
text.Puissance cyclique : les monstres ont +5: Puissance cyclique: monsters have +50% vitality; your damage gains +25% per turn from the 2nd turn on and goes back to base every 5 turns.
text.Disparitions détonantes : un monstre qui: Disparitions détonantes: a monster that dies hurts the monsters around it, based on its max HP.
text.Liaison longue portée : 20 % des dommage: Liaison longue portée: 20% of the damage a monster takes is sent to the monsters more than 10 range away from it.
text.Poussées revigorantes : une fois par tou: Poussées revigorantes: once per turn, a monster that takes pushback damage heals your characters around it.
text.Invocations incapacitantes : les dommage: Invocations incapacitantes: damage from your non-static summons removes 1 turn from the monsters' buffs.
text.Le combat se joue dans une seule salle :: The fight takes place in a single room: monsters arrive in waves, on set turns or as soon as the current wave is killed.
text.Au début : le boss et autant d'ennemis e: At the start: the boss and as many enemies in all as there are characters. Each wave has as many monsters as there are characters.
text.5 vagues en tout (3 dans la Mémoire d'Or: 5 waves in all (3 in Orukam's Memory and Imagiro's Memory), each on a turn set by the dungeon.
text.Tuer tous les monstres d'une vague avant: Killing every monster of a wave before that turn starts the next one at once.
text.En bas à droite de la timeline : le tour: Bottom right of the timeline: the turn the next wave arrives and the current wave.
text.Une nouvelle vague est invulnérable 1 to: A new wave is invulnerable for 1 turn, until the end of its first turn.
text.Les vagues réapparaissent sur les cases: Waves reappear on the monsters' starting cells. If monsters are still there, the new ones play at the end of the timeline.
text.À Osavora, dans la Cave du Toxoliath et: In Osavora, Toxoliath's Cave and King Nidas's Palace, monsters arriving from wave 2 on have 25% less HP.
text.Tuer chaque vague vite : sinon les vague: Kill each wave fast: otherwise waves pile up and you face 10 monsters or more at once.
text.L'icône en combat montre le modificateur: The icon in the fight shows the active modifier of Srambad (10 possible). It only changes when the level-200 dungeon, Throne Room of the Dark Court, is completed.
text.Coups Bas : tes dommages indirects (glyp: Coups Bas: your indirect damage (glyphs, traps, poisons, summons, bombs) gains +25%.
text.Berserker : un personnage sous 50 % de s: Berserker: a character under 50% of their HP at the start of their turn gains +33% damage.
text.Jeu dangereux : au début de son tour, ch: Jeu dangereux: at the start of their turn, each character places a trap at their feet that only hurts monsters.
text.Larcin : tes attaques en mêlée volent de: Larcin: your melee attacks steal life from monsters.
text.Évasion : tes attaques en mêlée repousse: Évasion: your melee attacks push monsters back 3 cells.
text.Entraves blessantes : chaque retrait de: Entraves blessantes: each MP reduction they suffer makes monsters lose extra HP.
text.Déplacements incapacitants : un monstre: Déplacements incapacitants: a monster that is carried, pushed, pulled or swapped loses 1 turn from its buffs' duration.
text.Solitude revigorante : au début de son t: Solitude revigorante: at the start of their turn, a character with no ally within 5 cells is healed for 10% of their vitality.
text.Solidaires : au début de son tour, un pe: Solidaires: at the start of their turn, a character heals based on the number of allies within 3 cells.
text.Distance mesurée : un monstre attaqué en: Distance mesurée: a monster attacked in melee loses 1 MP (3 at most); your characters take 20% less damage at range.
text.L'icône en combat montre le modificateur: The icon in the fight shows the active modifier of Xelorium (10 possible). It only changes when the level-200 dungeon, Eye of Vortex, is completed.
text.En quête d'action : chaque retrait de PA: En quête d'action: each AP reduction they suffer makes monsters lose extra HP.
text.Saute-Bouftou : un personnage qui frappe: Saute-Bouftou: a character who hits an ally is teleported symmetrically to that ally.
text.Retour arrière : un monstre qui subit de: Retour arrière: a monster that takes melee damage goes back to its previous position.
text.Actions entravées : tes dommages d'arme: Actions entravées: your weapon damage removes AP from monsters.
text.Solitude momifiante : au début de son to: Solitude momifiante: at the start of their turn, a character with no ally within 5 cells turns into a mummy and takes less damage for 1 turn.
text.Régénération critique : chaque coup crit: Régénération critique: each critical hit by a character heals them for 2% of their max vitality.
text.Roulette élémentaire : au début de son t: Roulette élémentaire: at the start of their turn, a character gains 200 Intelligence, Chance, Agility or Strength at random for 1 turn.
text.Case bonus : au début de son tour, des c: Case bonus: at the start of their turn, bonus cells appear 4 cells in line from a character: moving onto one gives them 2 AP for the turn.
text.Bonne distance : 20 % des dommages subis: Bonne distance: 20% of the damage a monster takes heals your characters exactly 7 cells away from it.
text.Naissance : un personnage qui finit son: Naissance: a character who ends their turn on their starting cell gains a shield for 1 turn; if they did not attack, they are healed for 5% of their life.
text.Chasse : achever un monstre donne au per: Chasse: finishing off a monster gives the character and their summons +1 AP and +3% final damage (2 turns, stacks 3 times).
text.Repos : qui invoque gagne +1 PM avec son: Repos: whoever summons gains +1 MP along with the summon (2 turns, stacks 2 times); at the end of its turn, the summon gives 15 Lock and Dodge to allies within 2 cells.
text.Chaque saison change aussi les monstres: Each season also changes the monsters: see the dungeon.
text.Jouer à distance. Les Morfrelon tapent d: Play at range. Dethornits hit from very far; wait for the Scoliopodes' Incurable Poison to end; deal pushback damage to Sculucanus before hitting them.
text.Chaque monstre change d'effet sous 50 %: Each monster changes effect under 50% HP: the Thirtree then gains Vitality per damage line, finish it with big single-line hits.
text.À son tour, chaque monstre met en Matoum: On its turn, each monster puts the monster nearest to it in Matoumorphose: its spells are strengthened (the Chakichan kills in melee).
text.Jouer à distance. Le personnage visé par: Play at range. The character targeted by Reflets placides must be the first to hit the Levitrof before their own next turn.
Don't end in melee with the Bigbit.
text.Chaque monstre renvoie 50 % des dommages: Each monster reflects 50% of the damage it takes onto everyone within 2 cells of it, its allies included. Don't end in melee with the Bigbit.
text.L'icône en combat montre le modificateur: The icon in the fight shows the active modifier of Enurado (10 possible). It only changes when the level-200 dungeon, King Nidas's Palace, is completed.
The icon in the fight shows the active modifier of Ecaflipus (10 possible). It only changes when the level-200 dungeon, Catseye Challenge, is completed.
text.À 10 % PV, un monstre passe en Lotus (in: At 10% HP, a monster enters Lotus (invulnerable, heals) and summons its double: kill it before the Lotus's 4th turn, or the monster comes back healed.
text.Inoffensif à distance ; ne se rue qu'à 2: Harmless at range; only rushes from range 2 or more: play at range or lock him. No one-shot in this version.
text.Inoffensif à distance ; n'attire qu'à 2: Harmless at range; only pulls from range 2 or more: play at range or lock him. No one-shot in this version.
text.à son tour, si tu as ≤ 30 % PV: on its turn, you at 30% HP or less
text.Placée au bord devant l'îlot et tapée au: Placed at the edge facing the islet and hit in melee without being killed, it teleports the character onto Nagate's islet.
text.Pousser Ben à son contact : l'explosion: Push Ben next to it: the explosion makes him vulnerable for 5 turns.
text.La Pougnette explose à son 5e tour et tu: The Maglob explodes on its 5th turn, killing enemies beyond 7 range: stand 1-7 range from it or kill it. Pushing a character into him makes him vulnerable 3 turns; pushing a monster into him heals him.
text.Se placer à 1-7 PO d'elle, ou la tuer av: Stand 1-7 range from it, or kill it before its 5th turn.
text.Ne pas finir son tour en ligne entre deu: Don't end your turn in line between two Stamper Wobots: bounced back and forth, the push damage kills. It works against the boss too: push him between two Stamper Wobots to one-shot him.
text.Chaque personnage commence le combat ave: Every character starts the fight with it, and every summon as soon as it arrives: -90% final damage and a Fire poison, until it is removed.
text.Poison : 190 à 265 dommages Feu fixes à: Poison: 190 to 265 fixed Fire damage at the start of each turn.
text.À partir du tour 2, elle retire aussi 10: From turn 2, it also removes 10% of current HP at the end of each turn.
text.Un soin la retire pour tout le combat, m: One heal removes it for the whole fight, even at full HP; lifesteal counts.
text.Tant qu'un personnage l'a, il n'attrape: While a character has it, they catch no other disease: keep it on those who don't hit, like a tank.
text.Gagne un bouclier à chaque tour : 50 % d: Gains a shield every turn: 50% of its vitality on turn 1, then 10% less each turn, down to 10%.
text.Gagne un bouclier à chaque tour : 10 % d: Gains a shield every turn: 10% of its vitality at first, up to 50% from turn 5.
text.Dans les royaumes d'encre et de papier e: In the Kingdoms of Ink and Paper and their dungeons, a monster at 10% HP enters Lotus and summons its double from the other kingdom.
text.En Lotus, le monstre est Invulnérable et: In Lotus, the monster is Invulnerable and Rooted, and skips its turn for 4 turns.
text.Il se soigne de 25 % de ses PV max à son: It heals 25% of its max HP on its 2nd Lotus turn, then 50% on the 3rd.
text.Son double apparaît sur la case au-dessu: Its double appears on the cell above it, with 25% less HP.
text.Tuer le double avant le 4e tour du Lotus: Kill the double before the Lotus's 4th turn: the monster dies for good.
text.Sinon, le monstre tue lui-même son doubl: Otherwise the monster kills its double itself and leaves Lotus: bring it back down to 10% HP.
text.Doubles : Imetsu et Tsunam, Imiyama et M: Doubles: Imetsu and Tsunam, Imiyama and Mabram, Imorok and Rokoram, Imushin and Shinlam, Imafugo and Fugokam.
A monster in Lotus can be carried.
text.Modificateur de la zone du Cauchemar des: Modifier of the Destroyers' Nightmare zone and its dungeon: ending your turn with no enemy in sight brings the Destroyers' Nightmare.
text.Un personnage finit son tour sans ennemi: A character ends their turn with no enemy in line of sight: the nearest monster summons the Destroyers' Nightmare 2 cells from them, for one turn.
text.Quand un monstre est achevé, les monstre: When a monster is finished off, the monsters in its line of sight become invisible for one turn.
text.Le Cauchemar a 17 000 PV, frappe fort, é: The Destroyers' Nightmare has 17,000 HP, hits hard, swaps places and creates illusions of itself.
text.Tant que le Cauchemar vit, le monstre qu: While the Destroyers' Nightmare is alive, the monster that summoned it can't drop below 1 HP.
text.Cauchemar à 50 % PV : il disparaît, tes: Destroyers' Nightmare at 50% HP: it disappears, your characters heal 10% HP and gain 20% final damage for 2 turns.
text.Sinon il disparaît après un tour : tout: Otherwise it disappears after one turn: everyone goes back to their starting cell, and the monsters gain 10% HP and final damage.
text.Un seul Cauchemar à la fois. Une fois pa: Only one Destroyers' Nightmare at a time. Once gone, it can't come back for a full turn.
text.Dofus du Cauchemar : invoquer ses deux F: Dofus du Cauchemar: summoning both Fantômes de Soldat in the same turn also brings the Destroyers' Nightmare.
text.Le guide conseille de le laisser dispara: The guide advises letting it disappear: going back to the starting cells often helps you.
text.Chaque ligne de dégâts qu'un Nimbos infl: Each damage line a Stubbyob deals to a character gives that Stubbyob a Stubbygerness (damage, then new spells at level III): keep them at range; MP reduction helps.
text.Cible prioritaire : au début de son tour: Cible prioritaire: at the start of its turn, a monster has a 10% chance to become a priority target; the first to hit it that turn gains 2 AP for 2 turns.
text.Après 5 attaques subies, chaque monstre: After taking 5 attacks, each monster triggers an effect based on the season.
text.Pas de modificateur de dimension : chaqu: No dimension modifier: each season has its own. The season changes every week; if the server misses the score, the monsters benefit from it too.
text.Les Krobes sont invulnérables : les tape: The Krobes are invulnerable: hitting them hurts the Malamoeba in their place; kill it before it has lived 2 full turns, or it kills your team. A Krobe only dies if its condition is held 3 turns in a row.
text.3 tours sans aucun soin: 3 turns with no healing at all
text.à 3 PO, selon ses PM restants: within 3 range, based on its MP left
text.Sans soin, il gagne de la Puissance à ch: With no healing, it gains Power every turn. It swaps places in a line up to 4 range, allies included, unless it is in Gravity: keep it away from the Viring.
text.Le personnage doit être à son contact au: The character must be in contact at the start of the Verminoculate's turn; a summon doesn't count. That character can change from one turn to the next.
text.Ses sorts ne se lancent qu'entre 6 et 10: Her spells can only be cast between 6 and 10 range. Her condition is checked at the start of her turn: none of your characters within 5 range.
text.La pousser contre un obstacle lui retire: Pushing her into an obstacle removes 1 MP for the fight without breaking her condition; at 0 MP she skips her turns. A Bashillus swap resets her condition and gives her MP back.
text.Brûlure d'estomac frappe une fois de plu: Heartburn hits once more for each element it received the turn before: meeting its condition makes it more dangerous, step away from it before its turn.
text.Indéplaçable, sauf par le premier coup d: It can't be moved, except by the first in-line hit of the turn, which pulls it into contact: walking it through a purple glyph puts it in Infection for 3 turns. Put it back in one at least every 2 turns.
text.Les Krobes sont invulnérables : tes coup: The Krobes are invulnerable: your hits on them hurt the Malamoeba, and each Krobe dies when its condition is held 3 turns in a row.
text.Début du combat : le premier monstre à j: Start of the fight: the first monster to play summons the Malamoeba (2000 HP per living character, companions included, summons excluded).
text.Si la Malamibe reste en vie 2 tours comp: If the Malamoeba stays alive 2 full turns, it kills your whole team: kill it before that, every time it comes back.
text.Taper un Krobe : la Malamibe subit tes d: Hitting a Krobe: the Malamoeba takes your normal damage. Hitting the Malamoeba itself: your damage is reduced by 50%.
text.Un sort qui augmente les dégâts subis se: A spell that increases damage taken goes on the Malamoeba, not on the Krobe you hit.
text.Malamibe morte : le prochain monstre qui: Malamoeba dead: the next monster to play summons it again. It loses 2000 HP when one of your characters dies.
text.Condition remplie : le Krobe passe en ét: Condition met: the Krobe enters the Infection state for 1 turn. 3 turns in a row: it dies. One missed turn: the counter restarts from 0.
text.Tabacille : aucun soin pendant 3 tours (: Bashillus: no healing for 3 turns (life steal is allowed).
text.Verminocule : un personnage à son contac: Verminoculate: a character in contact with it at the start of its turn (a summon doesn't count).
text.Bacterrib : aucun de tes personnages à 5: Bacterrible: none of your characters within 5 range at the start of her turn.
text.Virustine : ne pas la déplacer ni lui re: Viring: don't move her or remove her MP. A Bashillus swap counts as a move.
text.Pataugerme (donjon) : le taper dans les: Pathogerm (dungeon): hit it with all 4 elements (Earth, Fire, Water, Air) every turn.
text.Moins il reste de Krobes, moins tu as de: The fewer Krobes remain, the fewer targets you have to hurt the Malamoeba.
text.Le taper au CaC. Son piège téléporte à t: Hit him in melee. His trap teleports the nearest monster into your melee (not the Shihan). At 75 and 25% HP: +2 MP for 2 turns.
text.Son géoglyphe grandit à chaque phase (ca: His geoglyph grows each phase (7x7 square, checkerboard, infinite star). Just before each threshold, he heals at the start of his turn: push him to the next phase before he plays.
text.Tous les ennemis sont invulnérables tant: All enemies are invulnerable while the 8 fires burn: put them out one by one with the Extinction des feux state.
text.À la fin de son tour, le Founoroshi pose: At the end of his turn, the Founoroshi lays blue glyphs (more and more, 4 at most); they vanish at the start of his next turn.
text.Marcher dans un glyphe bleu donne l'état: Walking into a blue glyph gives the Extinction des feux state: -3 Range and -20 AP/MP dodge while you carry it.
text.Avec l'état, marcher sur la case marron: With the state, walking onto the brown cell right of a fire puts it out. You then lose the state: get a new one for the next fire.
text.L'état ne se cumule pas (un feu par état: The state does not stack (one fire per state); you keep it from one turn to the next until you put out a fire.
text.Les compagnons et les invocations mobile: Sidekicks and mobile summons can put out fires too.
text.Chaque feu éteint donne au Founoroshi 1: Each fire put out gives the Founoroshi 1 MP, 1 Range and 10% damage for 4 turns.
A fire that was put out relights after 8 turns.
text.Les 8 feux éteints : tous les ennemis de: With all 8 fires out: every enemy becomes vulnerable and stays so, and the Founoroshi becomes invisible.
text.Les feux peuvent encore se rallumer ensu: Fires can still relight afterwards: if all the fires relight, the whole team dies.
text.Une fois les ennemis vulnérables, tes pe: Once the enemies are vulnerable, your characters gain 15% damage every turn.
text.Taper un Tonneau anti-incendie : au CaC,: Hitting a Fire-Fighting Barrel: in melee, it pushes you back 3 cells and gives you 10% final damage; at range, it pulls you, heals you and shields you.
text.Les 8 feux éteints, tous les ennemis dev: With all 8 fires out, every enemy becomes vulnerable and the Founoroshi invisible. A fire relights after 8 turns: if all the fires relight, the whole team dies.
text.Explose à la fin de son tour au contact: Explodes at the end of its turn next to one of your characters: low Earth damage.
text.Chaque Tanuki est invulnérable sur un gé: Each Tanuki is invulnerable on a geoglyph (its own or another's): while it is on one, hitting it at range pulls it 2 cells, in melee pushes it 2. Get it off the geoglyph to hit it.
text.sans Tonneau Pirate collé à lui: without a Pirate Barrel next to it
text.Coller des Tonneaux Pirate contre lui :: Stick Pirate Barrels against him: each one takes 200% resistance off him in one element, the one that Barrel resists. Block him between the Barrels so he stays in contact with them.
text.Résiste à 100 % à un seul élément. Invoq: 100% resistance to a single element. Once summoned for 3 turns, on its turn it takes 200% resistance in that element off everything touching it, for 3 turns: Gourlo, but your characters too. It does not move.
text.Gourlo le Terrible a 200 % de résistance: Gourlo the Terrible has 200% resistance to everything: a Pirate Barrel next to him takes it off him, in a single element per Barrel.
text.Chaque Tonneau résiste à 100 % à un seul: Each Barrel has 100% resistance to a single element: that is the element it takes off. Look at its resistances in game.
text.Un Tonneau invoqué depuis 3 tours lance: A Barrel summoned for 3 turns casts Treacherous Rhum on its turn: -200% resistance in its element to everything touching it, 3 turns.
text.Gourlo doit être collé au Tonneau à ce m: Gourlo must be next to the Barrel at that moment: he drops to 0% in that element. A single Barrel is enough.
text.Pour qu'il ne s'éloigne pas : le bloquer: To stop him moving away: block him between 4 Barrels, or stick 1 Barrel to him and close his 3 other sides (characters, obstacles).
text.Garder les Tonneaux de l'élément dans le: Keep the Barrels of the element you hit in: they have 0 MP and do not move.
text.Tes personnages collés au Tonneau perden: Your characters next to the Barrel lose 200% resistance too; Treacherous Rhum heals Gourlo and gives him Damage.
text.monstres au CaC du perso soigné: monsters next to the healed character
text.te téléporte de l'autre côté: teleports you to its other side
text.3 PM à qui soigne sa cible: 3 MP from whoever heals its target
text.Poison pétrifiant (2 tours, désenvoûtabl: Petrifying Poison (2 turns, dispellable): Water damage at the end of your turn according to the AP/MP you used, and it teleports you next to the nearest monster. Under Lunar Target, using AP or MP avoids it.
text.Chaque personnage pose en début de tour: Each character lays a glyph at turn start that kills whoever starts or ends a turn in it. As soon as the Sporachnee ends its turn on one, the Korriander becomes vulnerable until the end of the fight, with 1 extra MP and 200 extra Power.
text.Perd 1 PM par coup reçu (3 max) : la fra: Loses 1 MP per hit taken (3 max): hit her or remove her MP, then push or pull her onto a glyph where she will end her turn. Pushed or pulled, she pushes back by one cell whatever is in her line. Killed, she comes back in 3 turns.
text.à plus de 6 cases du Globilum: further than 6 cells from the Globilum
text.Bouge d'une case par tour. Placer la Sil: Moves one cell per turn. Put the Silhouette in its white glyph (radius 3 circle) and keep Shadow outside it. Pushes back one cell whoever is next to it. Stay within 6 cells of it: Shadow hits further out.
text.Vulnérable si la Silhouette est dans le: Vulnerable when the Silhouette is in the Globilum's white glyph and he is outside it. Keep him away from the Globilum and take his MP.
text.Fuit après avoir frappé : elle doit fini: Flees after hitting: it must end in the Globilum's white glyph, which makes Shadow vulnerable if he is outside it. Hits Fire for 40 % of its target's eroded HP.
text.quand il est sur son îlot: when it is on its islet
text.2 tours si frappé à l'arme CaC: 2 turns if hit by a melee weapon
text.le placer sur 3 glyphes de morts: move it onto 3 dead monsters' glyphs
text.à distance : le frapper au CaC: at range: hit it in melee
text.au CaC : te change en monstre: in melee: turns you into a monster
text.s'attire sur le perso piégé: pulls itself to the trapped character
text.1 tour devant lui, 3 au réveil: 1 turn in front of it, 3 on waking
text.soi-même, sur un perso en Sursis: itself, on a target in Reprieve
text.Résistances s'il a les 4 états: resistances if it has the 4 states
text.PA, PM, PO, Fuite, Dommages CaC: AP, MP, range, Dodge, melee dmg
text.PA, PM, Puissance à un allié: AP, MP, Power to an ally
text.démonte si on soigne à son CaC: dismounts if you heal in its melee
text.PM et Dommages à mi-PV: MP and damage at half HP
text.bleu : permet d'éteindre un feu: blue: lets you put out a fire
text.état X à 10 de Colère et Haine: state X at 10 Bontarian and Brakmarian Wrath
text.attire en croix autour de soi: pulls in a cross around it
text.soi et alliés à 5 PO, 1 tour: it and allies within 5 range, 1 turn
text.soi et ses alliés, dès le tour 2: itself and its allies, from turn 2
text.Dommages et PM aux Blops royaux: damage and MP to Royal Blops
text.tous, s'il n'a que Floutage: everyone, if it only has Blurring
text.soi-même si on rate sa fuite: itself if you fail to dodge it
text.ses Dommages gagnés sur glyphe: the damage it gains on a glyph
text.autour de soi, selon ses PV: around it, based on its HP
text.début de tour, avant de bouger: at the start of its turn, before moving
text.Affaibli, puis saute ton tour: Weakened, then makes you skip your turn
text.meurent seuls, -25 % PV par tour: die on their own (-25% HP per turn)
